articles.title: Reframe: Observation-Aligned Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation for Agentic Visual Reasoning
articles.content: Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) and multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) offer complementary routes to post-training. For visual agents, however, tool use presents two related challenges. Models may overlook useful tool-returned observations, while poorly grounded actions can limit the evidence available for subsequent distillation. We introduce Reframe, a post-training framework that treats the observation state, rather than only the output distribution, as an object of alignment. First, Ground-Drop-GRPO (GD-GRPO) trains spatial and temporal specialists with evidence-aware rewards and stochastic removal of the original visual input, encouraging them to acquire grounded evidence and use the returned observations. Second, Observation-Gated-MOPD (OG-MOPD) replaces deficient tool actions with canonical ones mid-rollout and resumes distillation from the repaired observation. The two stages complement each other, as learning to rely on tool-returned observations can help the policy benefit from observation repair. Neither stage requires a task-specific SFT cold start. Extensive experiments over 14 image and video benchmarks demonstrate that Reframe outperforms both Mix-RL and vanilla MOPD. Ablation results show that GD-GRPO increases observation dependence and tool gain compared with outcome-based GRPO.

articles.content_zh: 代理强化学习(RL)和多教师政策提炼(MOPD)为培训后提供了补充路线. 但是,对于视觉代理人来说,工具的使用提出了两个相关的挑战. 模型可能忽略了有用的工具回放观测,而没有立足点的行动会限制可用于随后蒸馏的证据。 我们引入了Reframe,一个训练后框架,将观测状态,而不仅仅是产出的分布,视为对齐的对象. 首先,地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地 第二,观察-Gated-MOPD(OG-MOPD)将有缺陷的工具动作取而代之,取而代之的是Conontical的中滚出并恢复从已修复的观测中分馏. 这两个阶段相辅相成,因为学会依靠工具返回的观测可以帮助政策从观测修复中受益。 两个阶段都需要一个任务特定的 SFT 冷起步. 超过14个图像和视频基准的广泛实验表明,重新框架的表现优于Mix-RL和vanilla MOPD。 对比基于成果的GRPO,GD-GRPO增加了观测依赖性和工具增益.

articles.title: World In-Context Learning for Agentic Robot Manipulation
articles.content: Trained action policies write manipulation skill into network weights, tying what is learned to the distribution it is learned from. In-context learning (ICL) avoids this coupling but has not matched trained policies, because a demonstration recorded in another scene carries no feedback from the world the robot currently faces. We observe that what an agent learns in context is semantic, recording task steps and object roles rather than visual appearance, so experience gathered in one world transfers to another. Based on this insight, we propose World In-Context Learning (WICL), a paradigm in which a frozen model starts from a demonstration, rehearses the task in a world such as a simulator, and writes the feedback into its context rather than its weights. We build RoboScript, a modular infrastructure that implements WICL for agentic manipulation. From a single demonstration, RoboScript learns each task through rehearsal in simulation, freezes the learned knowledge as a Task Memory, and deploys the frozen memory on new scenes with data isolation that ensures every deployment input is available on a real robot. On all 50 tasks of RoboTwin 2.0, RoboScript reaches 83.4% mean success across clean and randomized settings with one demonstration per task and no gradient updates, exceeding the strongest trained action policy by over 20 points. The method generalizes across visual distributions, improves through reflection, scales with the foundation model, and transfers to a physical dual-arm robot through cross-embodiment memory adaptation. With a world in the loop, a robot can learn a manipulation task in its context as well as it learns one in its weights. All code is available at https://github.com/ArcheOne-AI/RoboScript

articles.title_zh: 用于代理机器人操纵的世界文字学习
articles.content_zh: 训练有素的行动政策将操纵技巧写入网络权重中,将所学到的与所学到的分布挂钩. 内语学习(ICL)避免了这种接合,但并没有匹配训练有素的政策,因为另一个场景中录制的演示没有从机器人目前面对的世界中带回任何反馈. 我们观察到,一个代理人在上下文中学到的是语义学,记录任务步骤和对象角色而不是视觉外观,所以在一个世界中积累的经验会转移到另一个世界. 基于这种洞察力,我们提出"世界内文学习"(WICL),这是一种由被冻结的模型从演示开始的范式,在模拟器这样的世界里排练任务,并将反馈写入其上下文而不是其分量. 我们建造了RoboScript,一个模块化的基础设施,用于执行WICL的代理操纵. 从一次演示中,RoboScript通过模拟中的排练来学习每项任务,将所学到的知识冻结为任务记忆,并将被冻结的内存部署在新的场景上,数据隔离可以确保每个部署输入都可用在真正的机器人上. 在RoboTwin 2.0的所有50项任务上,RoboScript达到了83.4%,意味着成功跨越了干净和随机的设置,每个任务一次演示,没有梯度更新,超过最强的训练动作政策超过20分. 该方法概括了视觉分布,通过反射得到改进,用地基模型进行平分,并通过交叉化的内存适应向物理双臂机器人转移. 有了循环的世界,机器人就可以在上下文中学习操控任务,也可以在重量上学习. 所有代码均可在https://github.com/ArcheOne-AI/RoboScript查阅

articles.title: Guiding Data Allocation for Robust Subpopulation Generalization
articles.content: Machine learning models often achieve high average accuracy in the training data while performing poorly on test data due to subpopulation shift. A common data-centric solution is to enforce balanced subgroup proportions, but full balance can be costly, infeasible, and not always necessary. In this work, we study whether balanced training data is the unique optimal configuration for robust subpopulation generalization. We extend a Gaussian feature-model framework to theoretically characterize the performance landscape across general training subgroup distributions. We show that multiple configurations, including substantially imbalanced ones, can perform comparably to the balanced one. We further derive gradient-based directions for adjusting subgroup proportions to improve adjusted accuracy and worst-group accuracy more efficiently. These findings suggest that strategically allocating data offers a more flexible and principled path to robust performance than simple balancing. The code is available at https://github.com/zhaoyingpan/subpop-data-allocation.

articles.title_zh: 为强壮的亚人口分布分配指导数据
articles.content_zh: 机器学习模型往往在培训数据方面达到高平均准确性,同时由于人口次转移,在测试数据上表现不佳. 一个以数据为中心的共同解决办法是强制实行平衡的分组比例,但完全平衡可能代价高昂,不可行,并不总是必要的。 在这项工作中,我们研究均衡的培训数据是否是强力亚人口通化的独特最佳配置. 我们扩展了一个高斯特色模型框架,从理论上描述整个一般培训分组分布的绩效。 我们显示,多种配置,包括严重失衡的配置,可以与平衡配置相对应。 我们进一步得出以梯度为基础的方向来调整分组比例,以更有效地提高调整后的准确性和最差分组的准确性。 这些调查结果表明,从战略角度分配数据比简单的平衡更能灵活和有原则地实现有力的业绩。 该代码可在https://github.com/zhaoyingpan/subpop-data-location上查阅.

articles.title: Beyond Modality Preference: Controlling Multimodal Arbitration under Modality Conflict in MLLMs
articles.content: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) integrate information across modalities, but become unreliable when those modalities disagree. Under conflicting inputs, MLLMs may favor modalities that are not the most reliable for the task, thus motivating inference-time control of modality arbitration. We identify a small set of attention heads, termed arbitration heads, that causally influence whether predictions follow visual or textual evidence. Building on this, we introduce a lightweight, training-free intervention that biases these heads toward a designated trusted modality at inference time. The identified heads are stable across calibration set sizes and generalize across settings, and steering them enables effective bidirectional control of modality reliance across diverse benchmarks. Our findings identify an effective control mechanism to align MLLM predictions with task-specified modality priorities. The code is available at https://github.com/zhaoyingpan/modality-arbitration.

articles.title_zh: 超越模式 优先权:控制在移动方式纠纷下的多式联运仲裁
articles.content_zh: 多种模式的大型语言模型综合了各种模式的信息,但当这些模式出现分歧时,则变得不可靠。 在相互冲突的投入下,MLLMs可能倾向于对任务不最可靠的模式,从而促使对模式仲裁进行推断时间控制。 我们确定一些小的注意头,称为仲裁头,这些注意头对预测是遵循视觉证据还是文字证据产生因果关系。 在此基础上,我们采用了一种轻而易举、无训练的干预方法,在推论时将这些头像偏向于一种指定的可信模式。 已查明的头部在各种校准设定的大小上是稳定的,在各种设置上是通用的,指导这些头部能够有效双向控制不同基准对模式的依赖。 我们的研究结果确定了一个有效的控制机制,以便根据具体任务模式的优先事项,对MLLM作出预测。 该编码可在https://github.com/zhaoyingpan/modelity-arbitation上查阅。

articles.title: Grasping the Future: Joint 3D Hand-Object Forecasting From Internet Videos
articles.content: To interact with an object, we need to anticipate both how it will move and how our hands should move with it. Human videos capture these relationships across everyday activities, offering a natural source for learning to predict future interactions. Learning from them requires recovering motion from completed interactions and using it to anticipate what could happen next. We present $\textit{Grasping-the-Future}$, a unified generative model of joint 3D hand-object motion, including wrist motion, finger articulation, and object position and orientation. Through masked spatiotemporal completion and flow matching, we train a single model for several prediction tasks: forecasting future interactions, predicting hand motion given object motion or vice versa, generating both trajectories toward a desired final object pose, and completing partially observed interactions. We explicitly model hand-object relations and incorporate contact constraints to help preserve grasp relationships during motion. To obtain 3D supervision from internet videos, we develop a scalable pipeline that combines pretrained perception models with joint geometric optimization to reconstruct completed interactions. We combine these recovered trajectories with annotated interaction datasets as training data for all tasks. We demonstrate strong performance across all tasks, outperforming released forecasters on datasets with 3D annotations. Moreover, we show geometric and physical plausibility of the predicted trajectories by retargeting them to a robotic embodiment. Videos are available at https://grasping-the-future.github.io.

articles.title_zh: 总结未来:联合三维手-目标预测 从互联网视频
articles.content_zh: 为了与一个物体互动,我们需要预见它将如何移动,以及我们的双手应如何与之一起移动。 人类的视频捕捉到日常活动中的这些关系,为学习预测未来互动提供了自然来源. 从中学习需要从已完成的相互作用中恢复运动,并利用它来预测接下来会发生什么。 我们呈现$\textit{Grasping-the-Future}$,一个统一的三维手-物体联合运动的基因模型,包括手腕运动,手指发音,以及物体位置和取向. 通过遮掩的瞬态完成和流相匹配,我们为几个预测任务训练出一个单一的模型:预测未来的相互作用,预测给定物体运动的手动,反之亦然,生成两个向所期望最终物体姿势的轨迹,完成部分被观测到的相互作用. 我们明确模拟手物关系,并纳入接触限制,以帮助在运动中保持抓住关系。 为了从互联网视频中获取3D监督,我们开发了可伸缩的管道,将预先训练的感知模型与联合几何优化结合起来,以重建已完成的相互作用. 我们把这些恢复的轨迹与附加说明的相互作用数据集结合起来,作为所有任务的训练数据. 我们在所有任务中展现出强效的性能,在3D注释的数据集上表现优于发布的预报器. 此外,我们通过将预测的轨迹重新瞄准机器人的外观来显示几何和物理上的合理性。 视频可在https://grasping-the-future.github.io上查阅。

articles.title: Click3R: Interactive Stereo 3D Reconstruction with Sparse Correspondence Clicks
articles.content: Despite impressive progress, existing feed-forward large 3D reconstruction models produce a single, irrevocable prediction. When these models fail, there is no mechanism to correct their mistakes. To address this limitation, we introduce Click3R, a framework for interactive geometric correction of feed-forward models using sparse human correspondence clicks. Given an image pair and a small set of cross-view point correspondences provided by a user, Click3R injects geometric constraints into the 3D reconstruction networks through a lightweight point correspondence adapter, enabling the model to resolve ambiguities in challenging scenarios such as repetitive textures, symmetric structures, large viewpoint changes, or textureless regions. To evaluate interactive reconstruction, we curate a challenging benchmark specifically designed to expose failure modes of existing feed-forward 3D reconstruction methods. Experiments show that Click3R reduces reconstruction error with as few as a single correspondence click, improving performance on both standard and our curated benchmarks. Our results highlight that sparse human interaction provides an effective and practical mechanism for correcting geometric reconstruction errors.

articles.title_zh: 点击3R: 用 Sparse 函授来重建交互式立体声
articles.content_zh: 尽管取得了令人印象深刻的进展,但现有的向导大型立体重建模型产生了一个单一的不可撤销的预测. 当这些模型失败时,没有纠正其错误的机制. 为了解决这一限制,我们引入了Click3R,这是一个使用人类微小的对应点击,对向导模型进行交互几何校正的框架. 鉴于一个图像对和用户提供的一小组交叉视图点对应,Click3R通过一个轻量级点对应适配器将几何限制注入了3D重建网络,使模型能够在重复的纹理,对称结构,大视角变化,或无纹理区域等具有挑战性的情景中解决模糊. 为了评价交互式重建,我们研究了一个具有挑战性的基准,专门用来揭露现有三维反馈重建方法的失败模式。 实验显示,Click3R减少重建出错,以尽可能少的单个函证点击方式,提高了标准及我们所制定的基准的性能. 我们的成果突出表明,人与人之间有限的互动为纠正几何重建错误提供了一个有效而实际的机制。

articles.title: SWAM: Scaling World Action Models with Cross-Modal Alignment
articles.content: World action models jointly predict video and actions conditioned on language. Existing studies focus primarily on architectures and training mechanisms, typically treating language-video alignment acquired through video pretraining as an established foundation. However, introducing action learning may impair this alignment. Principled guidance on data and supervision design for maintaining language-video alignment during action learning remains limited. To investigate this, we curate a pool of approximately 47,000 hours of general videos, egocentric videos, UMI demonstrations, and robot demonstrations. Building on this, we systematically study how language-video supervision, language-video-action supervision, and the joint use of these two forms affect WAM performance. In particular, we examine how language annotation quality affects pretrained language-video capabilities, and how action supervision from UMI and robot demonstrations extends these capabilities to language-video-action modeling. To better scale the model, we further conduct detailed studies on joint training recipe and model architecture. Under a fixed training budget, mixing egocentric videos and UMI demonstrations improves control generalization. Model architecture affects how effectively these experiences are used, while scaling pretraining under the selected configuration brings further gains. The resulting recipe, post-trained on RoboTwin Clean demonstrations only, achieves success rates of 88.10% and 61.56% under Easy (Clean-to-Clean) and Hard (Clean-to-Random) conditions, respectively. Our model achieves 40.00% SR across three real-world tasks, compared with 23.33% for the strongest baseline, indicating better generalization under unseen conditions. We release the curated data, training code, and model weights.

articles.title_zh: SWAM:通过跨模式协调扩大世界行动模式
articles.content_zh: 世界行动模型共同预测视视频和以语言为条件的行动. 现有研究主要侧重于建筑和培训机制,通常将通过视频预训获得的语言-视频对接作为既定的基础。 然而,引入行动学习可能妨碍这种协调。 关于数据和监督设计的原则性指导,在行动学习期间保持语言-视频一致性,仍然有限。 为了调查这一点,我们整理了大约47 000小时的普通录像、以自我为中心的录像、UMI示威和机器人演示。 在此基础上,我们系统地研究语言-视频监督,语言-视频-行动监督,以及这两种形式的联合使用如何影响WAM的性能. 尤其是,我们研究语言注释的质量如何影响预先训练的语言视频能力,以及UMI和机器人演示的动作监督如何将这些能力扩展到语言视频动作模型. 为了更好地推广这一模式,我们进一步详细研究联合培训配方和模式架构。 在固定的培训预算下,混合以自我为中心的视频和UMI演示可以改善控制通俗化. 模式架构影响这些经验如何得到有效利用,同时在选定配置下扩大预训范围,带来进一步收益。 由此产生的配方,仅经过RoboTwin Clean演示培训后,在Easy(清至清)和Hard(清至朗)条件下分别取得了88.10%和61.56%的成功率. 我们的模型在三个现实世界任务中实现了40.00%的SR,而最强基线则达到了23.33%,这说明在不见的情况下,通用性更好。 我们公布整理的数据 训练代码 模型重量

articles.title: AI-based characterization of lymphoid structures and the tumor microenvironment reveals lower mature tertiary lymphoid structures, lymph-node follicles, and plasma cells after neoadjuvant therapy in lung squamous cell carcinoma
articles.content: Mature, germinal centre-bearing tertiary lymphoid structures (TLS) and mature lymph node follicles (secondary lymphoid structures, SLS) sustain the plasma cell response that shapes outcome and immunotherapy benefit in lung cancer. How this loco-regional axis differs between neoadjuvant-treated and therapy-naive tumors is poorly defined. We analyzed H&E whole-slide images of resected tumors and paired proximal and distal lymph nodes from matched neoadjuvant-treated (neoLUSC, n=20) and therapy-naive (naivLUSC, n=20) lung squamous cell carcinoma (LUSC) patients. Aignostics Atlas H&E Tissue Analysis (HETA) models quantified cell densities per tissue compartment and cell-cell co-localization; a dedicated deep-learning model validated against pathologist annotations detected TLS and SLS and graded their maturity. Prognostic value was tested in an independent cohort (n=458; 46 treated). In neoLUSC tumors, stromal plasma cell density was 72% (p=0.004) and stromal lymphocyte density 48% (p=0.015) lower than in naivLUSC; macrophages and granulocytes did not differ significantly. Total and immature TLS did not differ, whereas mature TLS in the tumor (p=0.034) and mature SLS in the tumor-distal lymph node (p=0.003) were lower in neoLUSC patients. Peri-TLS plasma cell density correlated with tumor lymphocyte density in naivLUSC (rho=0.54, p=0.017) but not in neoLUSC tumors (rho=0.07). In the validation cohort, stromal plasma cell density (HR 0.69, p=0.011) and lymphocyte-plasma cell co-localization (HR 0.66, p=0.004) were associated with longer survival, and neoadjuvant status with shorter survival (HR 1.50, p=0.026). Neoadjuvant therapy is thus associated with fewer mature lymphoid structures and weaker coupling of the humoral compartment to the tumor rather than uniformly lower immune readouts. The stromal plasma cell/co-localization axis is a candidate prognostic biomarker.

articles.title: What kills $v$-prediction? A Patch-wise PCA Perspective on Pixel-Space Flow Matching
articles.content: Latent Diffusion Models dominate generative modeling but face two-stage training complexity and the inherent reconstruction limits of pre-trained autoencoders. Pixel-space Flow Matching offers a simplified end-to-end alternative yet often encounters training difficulties when using the standard $v$-prediction objective. Recent research attributes this difficulty to the off-manifold nature of noised targets, motivating a shift toward $x$-prediction. In this paper, we investigate this explanation through patch-wise Principal Component Analysis (PCA) and identify a bandwidth bottleneck. The velocity in minor components is largely determined by the raw noisy input, requiring deep backbones to preserve information that competes with principal-component modeling. Through controlled experiments and representation analysis, we further examine why $x$-prediction remains effective: its parameterization provides a raw-input bypass, while its learned input representation can spontaneously concentrate on principal directions. Under low-rank observations, our analysis of the induced flow characterizes $x$-prediction as an implicit conditional-mean decoder, reconstructing discarded components from the retained information. These observations motivate the Raw-injected Transformer (RiT), which combines a lightweight raw-conditioned decoder with an output-side shortcut to separate semantic modeling from raw-state propagation. Our method restores effective $v$-prediction and achieves competitive performance on ImageNet $256\times256$, providing a perspective on the interaction between prediction objectives and architectural bandwidth.

articles.title_zh: 什么杀死了美元预测? 关于像素-空间流匹配的补丁 PCP 视角
articles.content_zh: Latent Divusion Models在基因模型中占主导地位,但面临两阶段训练的复杂性和预先训练的自编码器固有的重建极限. 像素-空间相匹配提供了一种简化的端到端替代方案,但在使用标准的美元预测目标时却经常会遇到训练困难. 最近的研究将这一困难归因于匿名目标的非随机性质,促使人们转向美元预测。 在本文中,我们通过补丁主要组件分析(PCA)来调查这一解释,并找出带宽瓶颈. 小构件的速度主要由原始的噪音输入决定,需要深层骨干保存与主构件模型相竞争的信息. 通过有控制的实验和表示分析,我们进一步审查为什么x$预测仍然有效:其参数化提供了原始输入的绕道,而其学到的投入表示可以自发地集中于主要方向。 在低级观测中,我们对诱导流的分析将美元预测定性为一种隐含的有条件的 -- -- 平均分解器,从所保留的信息中重建被丢弃的组件。 这些观测激发了Raw-注射变形器(RiT)的动力,它结合了轻量级的原始条件解码器和输出侧快捷键,将语义模型与生态传播分离. 我们的方法恢复了有效的美元预测,并在ImageNet上实现了256\times256美元的竞争性能,为预测目标与建筑带宽之间的相互作用提供了视角.

articles.title: 2D Gum-Net: Unsupervised Dense Elastic Image Registration via Symmetric Correlation and Spectral Pooling
articles.content: Dense non-rigid registration, the recovery of a pixel-wise deformation field that warps one image into geometric agreement with another, is fundamental across medical imaging, structural biology, and correspondence estimation, yet learning-based approaches face a severe bottleneck: ground-truth deformation fields are notoriously difficult to obtain for real data. We present 2D Gum-Net, an end-to-end architecture that predicts dense elastic deformation fields fully unsupervised. We transfer the Geometric Unsupervised Matching Network (Gum-Net), originally developed for 3D subtomogram alignment in cryo-electron tomography, to 2D elastic registration: all three modules are redesigned in 2D, and the rigid transformation head is replaced by a Dense Spatial Transformer that regresses a sparse control-point grid, lifted to a full-resolution field $Φ$ by bicubic interpolation. Downsampling uses DCT spectral pooling, implemented as frozen-basis matrix multiplications ($\approx 50\times$ GPU speedup), preserving the fine, quasi-periodic structure that max and average pooling destroy. We evaluate on contact-based fingerprints, a challenging testbed for this task: locally self-similar ridge patterns make correspondence maximally ambiguous, skin pressed against a sensor generates authentic large-displacement elastic distortion, and minutiae act as precise landmarks through which an independent matcher externally verifies the topological correctness of predicted fields. Trained purely on synthetic impressions and evaluated zero-shot on real benchmarks, our method improves structural correlation by up to 15.7% on FVC2004 and raises genuine match scores under an independent matcher while leaving imposter scores essentially unchanged. This suggests that the predicted deformations restore true structure without fabricating correspondences.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 2D Gum-Net: 通过对称对等和相片集成进行无监督的外形弹性图像注册
articles.content_zh: 非刚性登记,将一个图像扭曲成几何协议的像素视向变形场的恢复,是医学成像、结构生物学和函证估算的根本,但基于学习的方法面临一个严重的瓶颈:地面-真实变形场对真实数据来说是众所周知的难以获得的。 我们提出2D Gum-Net,一种端到端的架构,预测密度弹性变形场完全不受监督. 我们把最初在低温-电子成像图中为3D子tomogram对接而开发的几何无监督匹配网络(Gum-Net)转移到了2D弹性注册:所有三个模块都是在2D中重新设计的,而刚性变换头被一个Dense空间变换器所取代,这个变换器会倒退出一个稀有的控制点网格,通过双相插入被提升到全分辨率字段$-$-. 下采样使用DCT光谱集合,作为冷冻-基质矩阵乘法执行(约合50\times$ GPU加速),保留最大和平均集合破坏的细而半周期结构. 我们评价基于接触的指纹,这是这项工作的一个挑战性测试板:当地自相仿的山脊图案使通信变得极其模糊;皮肤被压在传感器上会产生真实的大迁移弹性扭曲;微微分是精确的地标,独立匹配者通过该地标对所预测的字段的地貌正确性进行外部验证。 我们的方法在FVC2004上提高了高达15.7%的结构相关性, 并在独立配对者下提高了真正的配对分, 这表明所预想的变形在不虚构通信的情况下恢复了真实的结构.

articles.title: Complementarity-Driven Dual-Teacher Hierarchical Alignment for Zero-Shot EEG-to-Image Retrieval
articles.content: Decoding visual information from EEG is central to brain--computer interfaces and brain-inspired intelligence, and contrastive alignment with pretrained vision foundation models (VFMs) has become the dominant paradigm. However, existing methods align EEG solely with CLIP-family VFMs, leaving hierarchical visual information in neural responses under-exploited. To address this gap, we formulate a mechanism-paradigm correspondence view linking hierarchical visual processing (from appearance to semantics) to the complementary biases of cross-paradigm VFMs, with image-only models (e.g., DINO) and image--text models (e.g., CLIP) capturing distinct facets of this hierarchy. Guided by this view, we propose the Dual-Teacher Hierarchical Alignment (DTHA) framework. Concretely, a shared EEG encoder is supervised by frozen multi-blur CLIP and shallow DINOv2 teachers via dual-branch contrastive alignment, so each branch fully supervises the visual cues it emphasizes. A fused-retrieval objective learns adaptive weights to combine their complementary visual representations for zero-shot EEG-to-image retrieval. For the shared EEG encoder, we introduce the Attentive Modulated Scalp-Pattern Bank Encoder (AMSPBE), combining temporo-spatial attention with a learnable scalp-pattern bank for accurate, interpretable visual feature extraction, while modeling regional temporal dynamics and filter-bank topographies. On THINGS-EEG zero-shot retrieval, DTHA achieves 92.4% Top-1 accuracy, exceeding prior state of the art by 12.4 percentage points. Spatial, spectral, and representational-similarity analyses, together with THINGS-MEG evaluation, validate DTHA's effectiveness, biological plausibility, and cross-modality generalization. This complementarity-driven perspective shows that supervision from cross-paradigm VFMs enables more complete extraction of hierarchical visual information from brain activity.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 零热 EEG 对图像检索的互补- 双教师等级
articles.content_zh: 从EEG解码视觉信息是脑-计算机接口和脑启发智能的核心,与被预先训练的视觉基础模型(VFMs)的对比一致已经成为了主导范式. 然而,现有方法仅将EEG与CLIP-family VFM相配合,使得神经反应中的分级视觉信息开发不足. 为了弥补这一差距,我们制定了一种机制-paradigm函证视图,将分级视觉处理(从外观到语义)与跨paradigm VFM的互补偏差联系起来,只图像模型(例如:DINO)和图像-文本模型(例如:CLIP)能够捕捉这种分级的不同方面. 在这一观点的指导下,我们提出了双师级校对框架。 具体来说,一个共享的EEG编码器由被冷冻的多蓝CLIP和浅的DINOv2教师通过双分支对比对接来监督,因此每个分支都完全监督它所强调到的视觉提示. 一个引信-检索目标学习适应性分量来结合它们互补的视觉表现来进行零镜头的EEG到图像回取. 对于共享的 EEG 编码器,我们引入了Attentive Moduated Scalp-Pattern Bank Encoder(AMSPBE),将节奏-空间注意力与可学习的头皮-平面库结合起来,用于准确,可解释的视觉特征提取,同时模拟区域时间动态和滤波-银行地貌. 在 MOTIONS-EEG 零发取回上, DTHA 实现了92.4% Top-1 的精度, 超过 12. 4% 。 空间、光谱和代表性 -- -- 相似性分析,以及MOTIS-MEG评价,验证了DTHA的有效性、生物可信性和跨模式通用性。 这种由互补驱动的视角表明,通过跨参数VFM进行监管,可以更完整地从大脑活性中提取层次视觉信息.

articles.title: Anchor Behavior, Not Parameters: Rehearsal-Free Continual Learning with a Single Shared Prompt
articles.content: Prompt-based continual learning adapts a frozen pre-trained vision transformer by tuning a small set of prompt tokens. Recently, one-prompt methods which share one single prompt across all tasks make this paradigm maximally parameter efficient. The open question is how a shared prompt can keep the knowledge of old classes while being updated for new ones. Existing methods protect old knowledge in parameter space, where they freeze task-specific prompts, expand new components, or sparsely gate which tokens receive gradients. However, this method sacrifices plasticity, yet the drift it still permits in shared tokens can corrupt the prompt's function on past classes. What must be preserved is the prompt's behavior. We propose TEA-Prompt, which couples (i) a token evaluation module that assigns each prompt token a continuous, input-conditional relevance score injected into the attention logits, softly specializing tokens across tasks without discarding any of them, and (ii) an attention-behavior anchoring loss that constrains each token's attention output around class-specific query regions using only compact Gaussian query statistics without stored old images, weighted by the token's past relevance. Anchoring the attention value allows the parameters to continue updating freely, as long as their interaction remains unchanged. TEA-Prompt achieves state-of-the-art accuracy with markedly lower forgetting on CIFAR-100, ImageNet-R, and CUB-200 with only 0.38M parameters. Code is publicy available at https://github.com/cuonga1cvp/TEA-Prompt.git
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Anchor 行为,不是参数: 使用单个共享快取的再听-无连续学习
articles.content_zh: 即时持续学习通过调取一小组即时符号来适应被冷冻了的先入为主的视变器. 最近,一个瞬间的方法,在所有任务中共享一个单一的瞬间,使这个范式的参数效率最大化。 尚未解决的问题是,共享提示如何在为新课更新的同时保留旧课的知识. 现有方法保护参数空间中的旧知识,它们冻结特定任务的提示,扩展新的组件,或稀有的门,使信使得到梯度。 然而,这种方法牺牲了可塑性,然而,它仍然允许在共同的代号上漂移,可能会破坏催化器在过去的班级上的功能. 必须保存的是提示的行为. 我们提出TEA-Prompt, 夫妇(一) 一种标志性评价模块, 将每个提示性标记分配为连续的, 输入条件相关性的分数注入注意记录, 轻而易举地将标记用于任务, 而不丢弃任何一项任务, (二) 注意行为锁定损失, 限制每个标记的注意输出 围绕特定类查询区域, 仅使用紧凑的高斯查询统计数据, 而不使用存储的旧图像, 按标记的过去相关性加权。 确定注意值可以使参数继续自由更新,只要其相互作用保持不变. TEA-Prompt在CIFAR-100,ImageNet-R,和CUB-200上实现最先进的精度,并显著地更低地被遗忘,只有0.38M参数. 守则在https://github.com/cuonga1cvp/TEA-Prompt.git上公布。

articles.title: Plant Orbiter: 3D Plant Reconstruction and Generation with Video Diffusion Orbit Cameras and 3D Gaussian Splatting
articles.content: Modern digital phenotyping pipelines require the precise measurement of a range of 3D morphological plant traits. The accurate, high throughput acquisition of these traits helps breeders and researchers accelerate the development of new varieties, techniques and products. Recent advances in 3D technologies have enabled a rapid transition from 2D to 3D pipelines, but high throughput acquisition of digital 3D twins of plants remains a significant challenge due to complex morphology, thin structures and occlusions. In this paper we present Plant Orbiter, a new approach to generating 3D plants that leverages recent advances in video diffusion to produce high quality 3D Gaussian Splats of plants from a single image. We show that our method more accurately recreates plant morphology than other state-of-the-art methods, achieving the highest 3D F-score against all baselines, while being more practical for high throughput pipelines due to easier alignment and reduced cost of camera placement. Combined with a 2D diffusion model, we show that our method also achieves state-of-the-art results in the generation of 3D plant models from a text prompt.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 植物轨道器:3D 植物再生与生成 有视频传播轨道相机和3D高斯平板
articles.content_zh: 现代数字回旋管需要精确地测量一系列3D形态植物特征. 准确,高吞吐量地获得这些特质有助于育种者和研究人员加速新品种,技术和产品的发展. 最近3D技术的进步使得从2D到3D管线的快速过渡,但由于形态复杂,结构较薄和被封存,高吞吐量收购了数位3D双胞胎植物仍然是一个重大挑战. 在本文中,我们介绍了"植物轨道器"(Plant Orbiter),这是一种生成3D植物的新方法,它利用了视频传播的最新进展,从一个单一的图像中产生出高质量的3D高斯平板植物. 我们显示,我们的方法比其他最先进的方法更准确地再造出植物形态,在所有基线上达到最高的3D F分数,同时对高通量的输油管更实用,因为对接更方便并降低相机放置成本. 结合二维扩散模型,我们显示,我们的方法还实现了从文字快取生成三维植物模型的最先进结果.

articles.title: OptiCover: A Scalable and Multi-Surface Framework for Cold-Start Visual Optimization under Semantic Constraints
articles.content:
Selecting an effective cover photo is a critical yet understudied problem in visual merchandising for e-commerce marketplaces. On Airbnb, hosts upload many photos depicting different rooms, amenities, and points of interest, but must manually choose a single static cover photo that is reused across heterogeneous product surfaces. This creates substantial challenges: over 90\% of listing photos have no engagement labels, leading to a severe cold-start regime; guest preferences vary across surfaces and search intents, and visually captivating photos may be semantically misaligned with the underlying listing. At Airbnb scale, this corresponds to hundreds of millions of photos and hundreds of thousands of new uploads per day.
  We propose \emph{OptiCover}, a scalable framework for cold-start visual optimization under semantic constraints and multi-surface engagement signals. The framework combines (i) a photo candidate generator that identifies candidate photos through various proxies, (ii) lightweight vision heads applied to frozen CLIP embeddings for large-scale semantic scoring, (iii) a cross-modal grounding validator based on a vision-language model (VLM) that enforces semantic representativeness, and (iv) an Exploration Logging Module (ELM) that orchestrates the collection of randomized engagement data across heterogeneous product surfaces and contextual search intents.
  We evaluate OptiCover through extensive offline studies and multiple online experiments across HomePage, and Search surfaces. OptiCover is now deployed in production and performs tens of millions of photo swaps daily. Online results show a 1.5\% engagement lift on the HomePage and a 0.35\% increase in bookers on Search, generating millions of dollars in incremental revenue. Our findings suggest that action-space shaping and semantic constraints are primary drivers of performance.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: OptiCover:在语义限制下冷起伏视觉优化的可伸缩和多角度框架
articles.content_zh:
选择有效的封面照片是电子商务市场视觉交易中一个关键但未得到充分研究的问题。 在Airbnb上,主机上传了许多描绘不同房间、便利设施以及兴趣点的照片,但必须手动选择一张不同产品表面重复使用的静态封面照片。 这带来了巨大的挑战:90多张上市照片没有订婚标签,导致严酷的冷落起步制度;不同表面和搜索意图的来宾偏好不一;视觉上映照片可能与基本上市错配. 在Airbnb尺度上,这相当于每天有上亿相片和上下数十万相片.
我们提议\emph{OptiCover},一个在语义限制和多地表接触信号下冷启动视觉优化的可扩展框架。 该框架结合了以下内容:(一) 照片候选生成器,通过各种代位识别候选相片;(二) 轻量级视觉头用于为大规模语义评分而嵌入被冻结的CLIP; (三) 基于语义代表性的视觉语言模型(VLM)的跨模式地基验证器; (四) 用于协调收集不同产品表面和背景搜索意图的随机接触数据的勘探记录模块。
我们通过广泛的离线研究和在HomePage和Search表面的多重在线实验来评价OptiCover。 OptiCover现已投入生产,每天进行数千万次相机交换。 网上结果显示,HomePage上有1.5QQ参与电梯,而Search上的订户人数则增加了0.35QQ,从而产生了数百万美元的增收. 我们的调查结果表明,行动空间的形成和语义上的制约是表现的主要动力。

articles.title: Spaghetti Splatting: Differentiating Curvilinear Dirac Masses via Convolution
articles.content: In production systems, 3D geometry is represented by primitives such as points, lines, and triangles, as rendering hardware is optimized to generate images from them very efficiently. Learning such primitives from images by volume rendering is challenging, as they are Dirac masses defined at infinitesimal locations in space. EWA splatting, Poisson reconstruction, and 3D Gaussian Splatting overcome this by convolving Dirac masses with a low-frequency kernel, a recipe that generalizes along two axes: the kernel and the primitive. As points and triangles have already received significant attention, we investigate this recipe for curvilinear primitives, and introduce Spaghetti Splatting. We approximate curves by polylines whose convolution converges to that of the continuous curve, and volume render each segment so that connected segments composite without overcounting at their joints. For fast training and inference, we linearize the camera projection per segment, which also accommodates kernels beyond Gaussians, such as Beta kernels. As a point is a curve of zero length, our representation is a strict superset of 3D Gaussian Splatting. It remains competitive with the state-of-the-art on general scenes, outperforms methods specialized to line-like geometry, natively supports anti-aliasing, and produces long connected strands that are directly amenable to physics simulation.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 意面平板:通过Convolution 区分 Curvilinear Dirac 弥撒
articles.content_zh: 在生产系统中,由点,线,三角等原始物来代表3D几何,因为渲染硬件被优化,从中产生非常高效的图像. 通过体积渲染从图像中学习这种原始物是具有挑战性的,因为它们是在空间中无限地点界定的地拉克质量。 EWA花板,波森重建,和3D高斯花板通过将Dirac大众与低频内核联合起来来克服这个现象,这种配方沿两个轴线进行概括:内核和原始. 由于点和三角已经受到很大关注, 我们调查这种菜谱 对于曲边原始人, 并引入意大利面板。 我们通过聚线来大致的曲线, 聚线的演化与连续曲线的演化, 体积使每个分段都成形, 这样连接的分段复合, 而不在它们的关节上过量计算。 为了快速的训练和推论,我们把相机投影每段线性化,它也容纳了高斯人以外的内核,例如Beta内核. 由于一个点是一个零长度的曲线,我们的代表是一个严格地超集的3D高斯平板. 它在一般场景上仍然具有与最先进的竞争能力,优于专用于线状几何学的方法,本土支持反变相,并产生可直接被物理模拟所接受的长相相接的线条.

articles.title: GeoScope: Training-Free Program Execution beyond the Counting Horizon for Ultra-High-Resolution Remote Sensing Question Answering
articles.content: In ultra-high-resolution (UHR) remote sensing images, the objects that questions count in a region or relate by direction often span only a few pixels. Existing methods mainly decide where a vision-language model (VLM) should look and trust its answer in the chosen view. We show that this assumption fails for counting, and measure VLMs as one calibrates a sensor. All eight open VLMs tested fall increasingly short once a view holds more than a certain number of objects, about five for most on DOTA aerial images. This counting horizon narrows as views grow and objects appear smaller. An empirical power-law response model predicts the undercount a split recovers and the spurious counts it adds, and supports the rule of splitting only views beyond the horizon. In GeoScope, a text-only language model parses the question into a typed spatial program that fixes the region and its resolution. The VLM only grounds and counts within its operating range, and directions are computed explicitly from the grounded boxes. To our knowledge, it is the first UHR method to split views by a measured limit of the VLM. Without training, it improves Qwen3-VL-8B by 16.3 points on regional counting and 10.5 on spatial relations in XLRS-Bench, and has the highest reported accuracy, trained methods included, on regional counting and on the whole benchmark by question. On UHR-Micro it improves global and regional counting by 16.8 and 36.2 points, 15.6 of the former from splitting. On MME-RealWorld counting it gains 11.4 points, and we show that an option that is almost never correct yet often chosen distorts comparisons there. Project page: https://avalon-s.github.io/GeoScope/
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: GeoScope:超高分辨率遥感问题答案计数地平线以外的免费培训方案执行
articles.content_zh: 在超高分辨度(UHR)遥感图像中,质疑在一个区域中计数或按方向相通的物体通常只跨越几个像素. 现有方法主要决定一个视觉语言模型(VLM)在选择的视图中应该看哪里并信任它的答案. 我们显示这个假设在计数上失败了, 并且把VLM作为一个校正传感器。 所测试的8个开放VLM一旦看到超过一定数量的物体,就越来越不足,DOTA航空图像上的大多数物体大约为5个. 这种计数的地平线随着视线的增长而缩小,物体显得更小. 一个经验性的权力法反应模型预测分块回收和它所添加的虚实计数的低估,并且支持只将视图分割出地平线以外的规则. 在GeoScope中,一个只使用文本的语言模型将问题解析成一个可以固定区域及其分辨率的被打入的空间程序. VLM只在其操作范围内的根据和计数,方向从被禁用箱中明确计算出. 据我们所知,这是第一个以衡量的VLM限度来划分观点的UHR方法. 在没有培训的情况下,它在区域计数和XLRS-Bench空间关系方面分别提高了16.3分和10.5分,而且报告准确度最高,包括训练有素的方法、区域计数和整个基准逐个问题。 在UHR-Micro方面,它提高了全球和区域计分,增加了16.8分和36.2分,前者为15.6分。 在MME-RealWorld计算中,它得分为11.4分,我们显示,一个几乎永远不对却常常被选择的选项会扭曲那里的比较。 项目网页:https://avalon-s.github.io/GeoScope/

articles.title: Differentiable Inverse Rendering Recovers Intrinsic Properties from Intravascular Optical Coherence Tomography
articles.content: Medical images encode intrinsic tissue properties that indicate disease progression, yet these properties remain entangled with the system-dependent physics of image formation. Differentiable inverse rendering asks whether they are recoverable by inverting the imaging system's forward physics rather than through post-hoc correction. We address this in optical coherence tomography (OCT), focusing on the optical attenuation coefficient, a per-pixel marker of pathology and cellular composition. Conventional recovery relies on closed-form inversions limited to simplified light-tissue models, or learned methods coupled to specific imaging configurations. We instead recover per-pixel attenuation from a single OCT image by gradient descent through a differentiable physics-based forward model. We verified the method against analytical solutions, validated it on five in vitro phantoms, and applied it without modification to 29{,}269 clinical intravascular OCT images from 128 patients. The inversion needs no training data or segmentations and is portable across platforms and retrospective archives. Replacing the forward model or recovering another optical parameter leaves the optimization procedure unchanged. We demonstrate per-pixel recovery is tractable because gradient information scales to this high-dimensional problem, where gradient-free methods become intractable. Our work supports quantitative tissue characterization from OCT images and provides a framework for extension across imaging modalities and organ systems.

articles.title_zh: 从血管内光学一致性图谱学中分化的反向回收
articles.content_zh: 医学影像编码了内在组织属性,这些属性表明疾病的发展,然而这些属性仍然与图像形成系统依赖的物理相缠. 可分辨的反向渲染质质问它们是否可以通过倒置成像系统的前向物理,而不是通过后向修正来恢复. 我们在光学一致性成像法(OCT)中处理这一问题,重点是光学衰减系数、病理和细胞组成的每像素标记。 常规恢复依赖于封闭式倒置,仅限于简化的轻质问题模型,或与特定成像配置相结合的学习方法. 相反,我们通过一个基于物理学的不同前向模型,通过梯度下降,从单个OCT图像中恢复出每像素的衰减。 我们对照分析解决方案验证了方法,验证了5个体外幽灵,并且不加修改地应用到128个患者的29{,}269个临床血管内OCT图像上. 反相不需要培训数据或分区,而且跨平台和追溯档案可移植。 替换前置模型或回收另一个光学参数,使得优化程序不变. 我们显示每个像素的恢复是可拉动的, 因为梯度信息尺度 到了这个高维度的问题, 在那里,无梯度的方法变得棘手。 我们的工作支持从OCT图像中进行定量组织特征鉴定,并提供一个跨成像模式和器官系统的扩展框架。

articles.title: A four-step validation protocol for radiomic survival analysis in small cohorts: a body composition case study
articles.content:
Gastroenteropancreatic neuroendocrine tumors (GEP-NET) lack prognostic biomarkers, and computed tomography (CT)-based body composition radiomics at the third lumbar vertebra (L3) is a promising candidate. Small cohorts make high-dimensional radiomic models prone to overfitting and single-split evaluations variable and optimistic.
  This methodological study proposes a four-step validation protocol for radiomic survival analysis in small cohorts: (1) false discovery rate (FDR)-corrected feature selection, (2) a dual-path comparison of prior feature selection versus embedded regularization, (3) repeated nested cross-validation (CV) and (4) a negative control with Gaussian noise features. In 78 GEP-NET patients, 535 radiomic features from five L3 compartments were used to evaluate five survival models with Harrell's concordance index (C-index), time-dependent area under the curve (AUC) and integrated Brier score (IBS).
  Step 1 selected at least one feature in 18% of outer folds under noise (nominal level 20%) versus 84% with radiomic features. The dual-path comparison showed no consistent difference between strategies. Repeated nested CV reduced variability across seeds (41% median reduction in C-index standard deviation), but not enough to distinguish models. The nested CV C-index exceeded chance by 0.07-0.15 with radiomic features but not clearly under noise (0.40-0.42 with prior feature selection, 0.47-0.55 with embedded regularization). Frequently selected features tentatively linked greater subcutaneous fat, skeletal muscle compactness and texture to better prognosis.
  These findings suggest a modest prognostic signal in L3 radiomics, with considerable uncertainty that the protocol quantifies. The protocol may transfer to other small-cohort radiomic survival studies. Code: https://github.com/marielatalaveram/radiomics-survival-validation-protocol.

articles.title_zh: 在小群体中进行放射性活性分析的四步验证协议:身体组成案例研究
articles.content_zh:
胃内分泌神经内分泌瘤(GEP-NET)缺乏可预知的生物标记,而以图画(CT)为基础的第三根腰椎(L3)的放射线构成是一个很有希望的候选. 小型组别使高维辐射模型容易被过度调整和单片评价所变化和乐观。
本方法研究提出了在小群群中进行放射活性分析的四步验证协议:(1)假发现率(FDR)被校正的特征选择,(2)对之前的特征选择与嵌入式正态进行双向比较,(3)重复嵌入式交叉验证(CV)和(4)带有高斯噪声特征的负控制. 在78名GEP-NET患者中,有5个L3区间的535个放射特征被用来评价有5个生存模型的哈雷尔的相和指数(C-index),曲线下的时间依赖区(AUC)和综合布赖尔分数(IBS).
第1步在噪音下外折叠(名义水平为20%)至少选择了一种特征,而84%则具有放射特征. 双向比较表明,战略之间没有一贯的差异。 重复的嵌入式CV降低了不同种子的可变性(C-index标准偏差中位数减少41%),但不足以区分模型. 嵌入式CV C-index以放射特征而未明显于噪声下(有前作特征选择的0.40-0.42,有嵌入式正则的0.47-0.55)比机会多出0.07-0.15. 经常选取的特征暂时将更大的皮下脂肪,骨骼肌肉收缩和纹理与更好的预测联系起来.
这些调查结果表明,L3放射线的预想信号微乎其微,协议量化的不确定性相当大. 协议可以被转移到其他小管放射活性研究. 代码:https://github.com/marielatalaveram/radiomics-survival-validation-protocol. 中国植物物种信息数据库.

articles.title: National-Scale Crop Type Mapping in Morocco Using Google AlphaEarth Foundations Embeddings and the Fields of the World Field Boundary Map
articles.content: Recent geospatial foundation models have introduced a new paradigm for large-scale Earth observation by providing pretrained embedding representations that can be directly exploited for downstream tasks. In this work, we investigate the use of Google AlphaEarth Foundations embeddings for national-scale crop type mapping in Morocco. The proposed workflow operates directly on publicly available 64-dimensional pretrained embeddings using lightweight downstream classifiers, eliminating the need to process raw satellite imagery during model training and inference. The approach targets three crop categories, namely winter cereals, tree crops, and other crops. For nationwide inference, the Fields of the World global field boundary map is used to constrain predictions to agricultural parcels, enabling efficient large-scale mapping. Experimental evaluation on an independent test set over ten repeated runs achieved an average classification accuracy of (87.17 +/- 0.42%). Nationwide inference over Morocco was completed in approximately five hours, with the dominant computational cost arising from cloud-based retrieval of the embeddings rather than model execution. These results demonstrate the potential of pretrained embedding representations for computationally efficient national-scale crop type mapping.

articles.title: What Breaks Scribble-Supervised Segmentation? An Audit-Informed Benchmark for Scribble Annotation Robustness
articles.content: Scribble-supervised segmentation is typically evaluated with a fixed annotation set, leaving robustness to distinct semantic and geometric imperfections poorly understood. Motivated by an audit of 12,031 manual PASCAL Visual Object Classes (VOC) 2012 scribbles and prior work, we introduce six controlled perturbation operators. Class corruption, spatial offset, and directional perturbation directly operationalize audit signals. Stroke-length reduction is motivated by prior scribble studies, while random dropout and fragmentation serve as diagnostic controls. Each operator reports requested and achieved changes. We evaluate manual and automatic scribbles across two image domains, two principal backbone settings, and multiple training pipelines, with an additional MiT-B1 PFA anchor evaluation. In the five-seed Tree Energy Loss (TEL)-ResNet101 VOC study, mean intersection over union (mIoU) drops from 70.08 to 1.46 under class corruption, compared with 35.57 for spatial offset, 52.20 for directional perturbation, and 63.24 for stroke-length reduction at their strongest settings. At the evaluated endpoints, semantic-anchor corruption produces the largest degradation, while geometric and support responses depend on the pipeline and dataset. Our benchmark provides a reproducible protocol for diagnosing annotation robustness beyond clean-set accuracy. The operator code is available at https://github.com/Wmhiram99/scribble-operator-benchmark.

articles.title: Controlled Binary Assignment Flows
articles.content: This paper introduces a geometric approach to the representation and learning of time-variant parametrizations of deep assignment flows, for binary data labelings on graphs. Each edge carries an optimally controlled parameter flow in a 2-dimensional totally geodesic submanifold, based on objectives derived from a non-local linear scale space representation of the input data. The aggregation of triplets of such flows in 5-dimensional totally geodesic submanifolds is learned from data. The fusion of these flows determines the trajectory in the high-dimensional symmetric parameter space and by geometric integration the layers of binary deep assignment flows. Numerical results demonstrate the expressivity and the limitation of our highly parallel geometric local synthesis approach to high-dimensional deep assignment flow parametrizations.

articles.title_zh: 受控二进制任务流程
articles.content_zh: 本文为图上二进制数据标签引入了一种几何方法来表示和学习深任务流的时变参数化. 每个边缘都包含一个二维完全大地测量子磁倍中的最佳可控参数流,其取自输入数据非局部线性比例空间表示产生的目标. 从数据中可以了解到这种流动的三重体在五维完全大地测量子磁面上的集合。 这些流的聚变决定了高维对称参数空间的轨迹,并通过几何融合决定了二进制深分配流的地层. 数值结果显示,我们高度平行的几何局部合成方法对高维深度分配流参数化的表达性和局限性。

articles.title: When Does Sliced Inference Pay Off? Resolution, Tiling and Dense Fusion for Small Object Detection
articles.content: Sliced inference such as SAHI is the standard remedy for small objects in high-resolution imagery, but its gains are usually measured against low-resolution baselines. We revisit sliced inference with scale as the explicit variable and ask when tiling actually pays off. We compare seven dense detectors from four families on VisDrone and DOTA, under pre-specified hypotheses, calibration-only tuning and a single evaluation on held-out test data. Two findings emerge. First, much of the benefit attributed to slicing is a resolution effect: on VisDrone, a single pass trained at a higher resolution outperforms tiling with box fusion (merging decoded boxes) for every detector that could be trained at that resolution, and at equal compute a higher resolution helps more than a larger model. Second, tiles carry complementary information that box fusion wastes. We introduce SCAHI (Slicing with Coverage-Aware Hyper Inference), which accumulates the dense outputs of all passes with weights that give every image position the same total coverage, and reads objects off a peak grid fine enough to keep crowded neighbours apart. On identical passes, SCAHI outperforms box fusion for every YOLO detector on both datasets and matches it for FCOS. On DOTA, whose images far exceed the resolution a single pass can be trained at, tiles with SCAHI beat the best single pass for every detector, by 4.3 to 5.6 mAP50 at 2048 px, and replacing only SAHI's merge step by SCAHI adds 2.3 to 4.0 mAP50. An ablation attributes the gain to the border weighting and the resolution of the peak grid. Source code is available at https://github.com/beckerio/scahi.

articles.title: Towards Reconstructing and Recognizing Objects behind Fragmented Occlusion using Video
articles.content: Perceiving objects through fragmented occlusions, such as foliage, is a natural capability of the human visual system but remains a fundamental challenge for computer vision. This work addresses the problem of object reconstruction, or de-occlusion, in the presence of high-density, fragmented occlusions. We propose a reconstruction framework that operates on a sequence of grayscale images of a moving object, acquired by a single camera, either stationary or in motion. The algorithm estimates the object's relative positions across frames by jointly registering the images and optimizing the alignment parameters to maximize the contrast of their average, referred to as the integrated image. This integrated image serves as the reconstructed representation of the object. Experimental evaluations on both synthetic and real video sequences demonstrate the feasibility of accurate reconstruction under occlusion densities exceeding 90%. The proposed approach is competitive with synthetic aperture techniques, which are limited to static objects and require complex camera setup with careful calibration. Furthermore, we show that the integrated image enables reliable object classification under severe occlusion when used as input to standard, off-the-shelf classifiers.

articles.title: Direct Conditioning of Audio Diffusion Transformers on fMRI Reveals Cortical Contributions to Sound Reconstruction
articles.content: Reconstructing audio from brain activity remains challenging. Existing brain-to-audio pipelines typically map neural responses to predefined stimulus representations before synthesis. While recent work in the visual domain has explored direct conditioning on brain activity, this approach has not yet been extended to audio diffusion models. We introduce MAAS (Multi-Area Auditory Synthesis), an end-to-end framework that conditions a pretrained audio diffusion transformer on ROI-wise fMRI responses without first supervising a decoder to predict an external stimulus representation. MAAS uses region-specific projections and learned brain tokens to condition Stable Audio through a dedicated cross-attention pathway. On a 7T fMRI dataset, we demonstrate consistent improvements over baselines, including two-stage fMRI-to-latent conditioning, across both acoustic and semantic evaluation metrics. In addition, we introduce a fidelity metric grounded in a computational model of auditory neural processing, which allows us to quantify the contribution of individual auditory cortical regions to reconstructed audio representations.

articles.title_zh: 在 fMRI Reveals 上直接配置音频扩散变换器对声音重建的贡献
articles.content_zh: 从大脑活动中重建音频仍然具有挑战性。 现存的脑到声管一般在合成前会绘制神经对预定义的刺激表现的反应图. 虽然最近视觉领域的工作探索了大脑活性的直接条件,但这种方法尚未被推广到音频传播模型. 我们引入了MAAS(多领域审计综合),这是一个端到端的框架,它以预先训练的音频传播变压器为条件,对ROI-wise fMRI的响应不首先监督解码器来预测外部刺激的表示. MAAS利用特定区域的预测和所学的大脑符号,通过专用的交叉注意路径为Stable Audio提供条件。 在一个7T fMRI数据集上,我们显示比基线的一致改进,包括两个阶段的fMRI到纬度调节,包括声学和语义学评价指标。 此外,我们引入了一个基于听觉神经处理计算模型的忠诚度度量标准,它使我们能够量化单个听觉皮层区域对重建音频表达的贡献.

articles.title: Evaluating Cross-Signal Coherence in Mammography Vision-Language Models
articles.content: As vision-language models (VLMs) move toward interpreting medical images directly, their outputs increasingly include not just a label but a stated confidence and a written justification. Yet the field still predominantly evaluates VLMs using just accuracy. We evaluate the coherence between answer, confidence, and explanation across four VLMs on breast density and BI-RADS categorization, using two mammography datasets. We perform controlled perturbations of the question, multiple choice option orders, and the images and assess changes in the three outputs. Our results suggest confidence does not decrease even as the mammography image is changed. Shuffling the options also changes most VLMs' answers. Notably, there are cases where a model's own stated reasoning contradicts its final answer, a distinction accuracy alone cannot capture but one that governs whether an AI-generated answer can be trusted.

articles.title_zh: 评价乳房外观-语言模型的跨部门一致性
articles.content_zh: 随着视觉语言模型(VLMs)向直接解释医疗图像的方向发展,其产出越来越多地不仅包括一个标签,而且包括一个声明的信心和书面理由。 然而,这个领域仍然主要使用准确性来评估自愿酰胺。 我们利用两个乳房X线照相数据集,评估四个关于乳房密度的VLM和BI-RADS分类的答案、信心和解释之间的一致性。 我们执行对问题的可控扰动、多重选择选择命令、图像和评估三个产出的变化。 我们的结果表明,即使乳房X光照片被改变,信心也不会下降。 shuffing the options也改变大多数VLMs的答案. 值得注意的是,在有些情况下,一个模型自己陈述的推理与它的最后答案相矛盾,单是区分的准确性是不能捕捉到的,而只能支配AI生成的答案是否可以信任。

articles.title: GHiML: VLM-Guided Hierarchical Multi-Label Learning with Applications to Benthic Imagery
articles.content: Vision language models (VLMs) encode substantial expert knowledge within their weights, yet their direct application to specialised classification domains such as benthic imagery remains limited. Meanwhile, vision transformers trained on these tasks rely predominantly on low-level visual latents (colours, textures, and shapes) that lack the higher-level reasoning humans employ for identification. We propose Guided Hierarchical Multi-Label (GHiML) learning, a pipeline that extracts conceptual latent variables from a VLM conditioned on training data, generates sample-relevant captions grounded in those variables, and fuses the resulting textual embeddings with image embeddings via cross-attention and a per-node gated router. We also introduce the inverted HML score ($d_{\mathrm{inv}}$), a similarity score that evaluates hierarchical multi-label predictions through graph traversal distance and a cardinality penalty, providing an interpretable alternative to existing measures, which are insensitive to realistic degradations in sparse, deep hierarchies. Experiments on BenthicNet, FathomNet and iNaturalist show that the router improves macro $F_1$ over the vision-only baseline by up to 6.7 pp and $d_{\mathrm{inv}}$ by up to 21.1 pp on in-domain benthic data, with gains persisting under distribution shift. Ablations locate the contribution of the text itself: on the multi-label biotic hierarchies, removing the per-sample text signal degrades $d_{\mathrm{inv}}$ while leaving macro $F_1$ unchanged, consistent with text acting through prediction cardinality rather than node discrimination, whereas iNaturalist, whose annotations are single-label, loses 18.7% of macro $F_1$. Our results support the hypothesis that VLMs contain exploitable specialised knowledge that, when appropriately elicited, can augment classification in domains where direct visual learning is insufficient.

articles.title_zh: GHIML: VLM- Guided 分级的多标签学习, 应用到 Benthic 图像学
articles.content_zh: 远景语言模型(VLMs)在其权重范围内编码了大量的专家知识,但直接应用于海底图像等专门分类领域仍然有限。 同时,在这些任务方面受过培训的视变器主要依靠低等视觉潜伏物(颜色、纹理和外形),而这些潜伏物缺乏人类用于识别的更高级推理。 我们提议进行有指导的分层多标签学习,这是从以培训数据为条件的VLM中提取概念性潜在变量的管道,生成基于这些变量的与样本相关的标题,并将由此产生的文字嵌入与图像嵌入相通和每节门路由器相接而成。 我们还引入了倒转的HML分数(d_{\mathrm{inv}}$}}$),这是一个类似分数,它通过图轨相距来评价分级多标签的预测和最基本的惩罚,为现有的措施提供了一个可解释的替代方法,这些方法对稀有而深层次的现实退化不敏感. 在BenthicNet、FathomNet和iNaturalist上的实验显示,路由器将宏F_1美元高于仅视基线,最多可达6.7pp;在域内底栖数据上,可达21.1pp;在分配转移中,收益持续增加。 查找文本本身的贡献:在多标签生物分级上,去除每个样本的文本信号会降解$d_{\mathrm{inv}}$,而保留宏$F_1$不变,与文本通过预测核心作用而不是节点区分作用一致,而iNaturalist作为单标签的说明,损失了宏$F_1$的18.7%. 我们的结果支持这样的假设,即:VLM包含可被利用的专门知识,这些知识在适当引出后,可以在直接视觉学习不足的领域加强分类。

articles.title: WanderBench: Can World Models Explore Dynamic Worlds from Video?
articles.content: Video world models conditioned on an input video make it possible to explore real, recorded dynamic scenes, enabling re-shooting of footage, free-viewpoint replay, and real-to-sim environments for embodied agents. Such uses require the generated rollout to stay faithful to the recorded world, yet existing benchmarks start from a single image or a text prompt, and video-conditioned generation is evaluated mainly on perceptual quality and camera following. These evaluations do not directly assess whether exploration preserves subject identity, event progression, and scene consistency upon revisiting a location. We introduce WanderBench, a benchmark for exploring dynamic worlds from video. It comprises 745 single-shot source videos of real and AI-generated content in three difficulty tiers (3-25 s), paired with camera routes given as keyboard actions, and evaluates six dimensions with 24 human-validated sub-metrics. Benchmarking eight models, we find that as clips grow longer, models keep the static scene and visual quality but lose camera control and the source dynamics, and that none keeps revisited places consistent. We further propose WanderLand, a training-free framework that conditions each frame of a frozen model on the same-instant source and, on revisits, on its own earlier static content. WanderLand improves five models on every dimension, by up to 8.3 points in source-dynamics fidelity.

articles.title_zh: Wander Bench:世界模型能否从视频中探索动态世界?.
articles.content_zh: 以输入视频为条件的视频世界模型可以探索真实的,被记录的动态场景,使得能够重新拍摄镜头,自由取景重放,以及给被体现的代理商提供真实到图像的环境. 这种用途要求所生成的推出要忠于记录的世界,而现有的基准则从一个单一的图像或文字提示开始,视像条件的生成主要根据知觉质量和相机跟踪来评价。 这些评价没有直接评估勘探是否保留了主题特征、事件进展和地点一致性。 我们介绍万德·本奇 从视频中探索动态世界的基准 它由745个真实和AI生成内容的单镜头源视频组成,分为三个难度级(3-25 s),与作为键盘动作的相机路线对接,并评价了6个维度,其中24个为人验证的子度量. 以8个模型为基准,我们发现,随着剪辑时间的延长,模型保持了静态场景和视觉质量,但失去了相机控制和源动力学,没有哪个模型能够保持重温地点的一致性. 我们进一步提出"漫游地"(WanderLand),这是一个免费培训的框架,将被冻结的模型的每个框架条件都建立在同源的同源地上,并在重新审视时,以它自己较早的静态内容来进行. 摇摆 土地在每个维度上改进了5个模型,在源动力学的忠诚度上提高了8.3分.

articles.title: EditJudge-Bench: Auditing VLM Image-Edit Judges with Synthetic Ground Truth
articles.content: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used as automated judges for image-editing benchmarks, yet their reliability is poorly understood. Auditing these judges is difficult because real edited images lack controlled ground truth and entangle the requested changes with model artefacts, unintended side effects, and ambiguous degrees of success. In this paper, we introduce EditJudge-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark of 1,382 synthetic before/after image pairs rendered in Blender, with edits parameterised across nine categories derived from real user requests and exact ground truth from known 3D scene parameters. Because every edit is generated by a known intervention on a controlled scene, EditJudge-Bench evaluates VLM judges as binary verifiers of whether an instruction was correctly executed, isolating judge perception from editor quality. Across 25 judge configurations, we find substantial reliability gaps: (a) the widely adopted VIEScore template reaches only 69.0% AUROC with GPT-4o; (b) fine-tuned judges score 51.7-66.3%; spatial edits such as rotation and shape remain challenging; (c) prompt-formatting choices like image-text ordering shift performance by up to 14.1 points. Despite using only synthetic data, judge rankings on EditJudge-Bench correlate strongly with two real-image human-preference benchmarks ($ρ$=0.95 and $ρ$=0.71), indicating that controlled audits surface failure modes relevant to real evaluation.

articles.title_zh: 编辑法官- Bench: 审计 VLM 具有合成地面真相的图像编辑法官
articles.content_zh: 愿景语言模型(VLMs)被越来越多地用作图像编辑基准的自动判断器,然而其可靠性却不甚为被理解. 审计这些判断很困难,因为真实的被编辑的图像缺乏可控的地面真相并用模型工艺、意外的副作用和模棱两可的成功程度来纠缠所要求的变化。 在本文中,我们介绍了Edit Judge-Bench,这是Blender所渲染的1,382个图像成对之前/之后合成的诊断基准,其编辑参数分为9个类别,分别取自真实用户的要求和从已知的3D场景参数得出的准确的地面真相. 由于每一次编辑都是由一个被控制的场景上已知的干预产生的,Edit Judge-Bench评价VLM评委是二进制验证员,以判断某一指令是否被正确执行,将法官的认知与编辑质量相隔离. 在25个法官配置中,我们发现存在很大的可靠性差距:(a) 广泛采用的VIEScore模板与GPT-4o相比只达到69.0%的AUROC;(b) 微调的法官得分为51.7%-66.3%;旋转和形状等空间编辑仍然具有挑战性;(c) 快速格式化的选择,如图像文本命令转换性能最高可达14.1分。 尽管只使用合成数据,法官在Edition Judge-Bench上的排名与两个实际形象的人优基准(美元=0.95美元和美元=0.71美元)密切相关,表明控制下的审计表面故障模式与实际评价有关。

articles.title: MARS: Multiscale Appearance-Residual Streams for Video Forgery Detection
articles.content: Generalizing deepfake detection across facial manipulation and fully generated video remains challenging due to forgery traces varying with the manipulation method and scene content. Explicit spatial and temporal feature differences offer a way to capture this variation, but also respond to natural texture and motion, motivating their joint interpretation with appearance features. We investigate whether combining multiscale feature differences with adapted appearance representations improves detection across both forgery categories. We introduce Multiscale Appearance-Residual Streams (MARS), a two-path video detector. The residual path applies fixed spatial and temporal difference-of-Gaussians operators to frozen intermediate features and models the resulting differences alongside appearance context across frames. The semantic path adapts the encoder's normalization parameters for frame classification, and a clip-dependent gate combines their predictions. Under a shared protocol across seven datasets, MARS achieves the highest average AUROC of 91.43\%, outperforming seven compared detectors. When trained on facial manipulations alone, MARS achieves 93.99\% AUROC on GenVideo and 75.50\% on DF26, demonstrating transfer to generated videos without generated-video training data. MARS also provides signed patch and frame contributions, whose faithfulness we evaluate through controlled spatial and temporal removal against random controls. MARS is publicly available for research: Project page: https://vectorinstitute.github.io/mars/ Github: https://github.com/VectorInstitute/mars

articles.title_zh: MARS: 视频伪造检测的多尺度外观-反应流
articles.content_zh: 将深假检测从面部操纵到完全生成的视频概括起来仍然是挑战性的,因为与操纵方法和场景内容不同的伪造痕迹. 明确的空间和时间特征差异提供了一种捕捉这种变化的方法,但也对自然纹理和运动作出反应,促使它们与外观特征共同解释。 我们调查,将多尺度特征差异与适应性外观表现相结合,是否会改进对两种假冒类别的检测。 我们引入了多尺度外观-residual Streams(MARS),一种双向视频探测器. 剩余路径将固定空间和时间差异的-------------操作员用于冻结的中间特征并模拟由此产生的差异以及跨框架外观上下文。 语义路径为帧分级调整了编码器的常态参数,一个以剪接为主的门结合了它们的预测. 根据跨越7个数据集的共享协议,MARS实现最高的平均值为91.43\%(AUROC),优于7个相较探测器. 仅接受面部操控训练后,MARS在GenVideo上实现了93.99\%AUROC,在DF26上实现了75.50\%,演示向生成的视频的传输而无需生成-视频训练数据. MARS还提供被签名的补丁和帧贡献,我们通过对照随机控制的可控空间和时间去除来评价其忠诚度. MARS公开供研究: 项目网页:https://vectorinstitut.github.io/mars/ Github: https://github.com/维克多研究所/马尔斯

articles.title: Perturb, Aggregate then Reconstruct: Consensus Aggregation and Fourier-Attended Multi-Decoders for Reconstruction-based Multi-View Anomaly Detection
articles.content: Multi-view anomaly detection is crucial for industrial inspection to identify defects hidden from single viewpoints. Yet, despite their strong success in single-view applications, reconstruction-based methods remain largely underexplored in multi-view settings. A key challenge in extending these methods lies in generating view-consistent pseudo-anomalies. To address this, we propose PAR, a reconstruction-based framework for enhanced multi-view anomaly detection. First, we introduce a feature perturbation strategy coupled with a consensus aggregation module that integrates these perturbed features across viewpoints to mitigate view-inconsistent anomalies and construct highly aligned pseudo-anomaly representations. Second, we employ a view-specialized multi-decoder architecture; by assigning a dedicated decoder to each view, we increase the model's representational complexity, enabling the generation of highly feasible, localized anomaly maps rather than less precise, view-agnostic reconstructions. Last, we incorporate Fourier attention into the decoders to emphasize global frequency-domain structures over local token evidence, effectively preventing identity mapping. Extensive experiments on the Real-IAD dataset demonstrate that PAR consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods in sample-level, image-level, and pixel-level anomaly detection. Our code is available at https://github.com/SpatialAILab/PAR_mvad.

articles.title_zh: Perturb, 聚合再重建:共识聚合和傅里叶出席的基于重建的多极分光器多极分光探测器
articles.content_zh: 多视角异常检测对于工业检查发现从单一角度隐藏的缺陷至关重要。 然而,尽管在单一观点应用方面非常成功,但基于重建的方法在多观点环境中仍然在很大程度上没有得到充分利用。 推广这些方法的关键挑战在于产生与视野一致的伪神经病. 为了解决这一问题,我们提议建立基于重建的框架,加强多视图异常探测。 首先,我们采用了一个特征扰动战略,同时采用了一个共识汇总模块,将不同观点的这些扰动特征结合起来,以缓解视向不一致的异常现象并构建高度一致的伪异常表述。 其次,我们采用了一个有视野特色的多解码器架构;通过为每个视图分配一个专用解码器,我们增加了模型的代表性复杂性,使得能够生成高度可行,局部性的异常地图,而不是不太精确的,可视-不可知的重建. 最后,我们把Fourier的注意力纳入解码器中,强调全球频域结构而不是本地的标语证据,有效地防止了身份映射. 对Real-IAD数据集的广泛实验表明,PAR在样本级,图像级和像素级异常检测中,其性能始终高于最先进的方法. 我们的代码可在https://github.com/SPatialAILab/PAR_mvad上查阅。

articles.title: V3DSAM: Semantic-Geometric Loop Verification and Geometry-Anchored Persistent Instance Mapping for Feed-Forward Dense SLAM
articles.content: To address unreliable cross-view association in long-sequence feed-forward dense SLAM, this letter presents V3DSAM, an open-vocabulary semantic dense SLAM system that establishes physical correspondences at both the scene and object levels. The system combines feed-forward geometric estimates from VGGT-SLAM 2.0 with open-vocabulary semantic observations from SAM3. We introduce semantic-geometric dual-scale loop verification, which identifies false loop closures using pixel-level bidirectional reprojection and object-level 3D spatial correspondences, without accessing backbone-internal features. We further propose geometry-anchored persistent instance mapping, which defines physical instances through class-constrained 3D connectivity in an optimized global coordinate system and assigns global IDs without inter-frame identity propagation. The proposed verifier rejects all four false loop candidates in our TUM RGB-D evaluation, while long-sequence ScanNet experiments show improved instance identity consistency. Thus, V3DSAM reduces dependence on internal backbone features and temporal ID propagation for robust long-term cross-view association.

articles.title_zh: V3DSAM:供饲料-前卫-外卫-SLAM使用的语义-地圈验证和地圈-地圈-地圈-地圈图
articles.content_zh: 为了解决长序回馈-向后稠密的 SLAM 中不可靠的交叉视图关联问题,本信介绍了 V3DSAM,一种开通-vobulary semic 稠密的 SLAM 系统,在现场和物体两级建立物理通信. 该系统结合了从VGGT-SLAM 2.0得到的向导几何估计,以及从SAM3得到的开放式语义观测. 我们引入了语义-几何双相阶回路校验,通过像素级双向再投影和对象级三维空间对接来识别假回路闭路,而不访问主干-内部特性. 我们进一步建议绘制几何 -- -- 受干扰的持久实例图,该图通过优化全球坐标系统中受类约束的三维连通来界定物理实例,并在不传播框架间身份的情况下指定全球标识。 提议的核查员拒绝我们TUM RGB-D评价中所有四个虚假的回路候选人,而长序ScanNet实验显示实例识别一致性得到提高。 因此,V3DSAM可以减少对内部骨干特征和时间标识传播的依赖,以建立强有力的长期交叉视图联系。

articles.title: LongSCOP: Semantically Consistent Long Video Outpainting
articles.content: Video out-painting is an important problem, yet existing research focuses primarily on short clips, leaving long video out-painting largely underexplored. Extending video out-painting to long videos poses substantial challenges. A natural solution is iterative out-painting, i.e., generating videos chunk by chunk, but this introduces two major issues: generation instability or even failure caused by inter-chunk inconsistencies and error accumulation, and semantic drift over long temporal horizons. In this paper, we propose LongSCOP, short for Semantically Consistent long Video Out-Painting. First, we introduce a training recipe with three components for smooth and stable long-horizon generation: self-forcing training, latent calibration, and future references. Beyond generation stability, we recognize that the rich temporal context of long videos provides valuable references for maintaining semantic consistency. We therefore develop a VLM-based agent that automatically selects the most informative reference frames from the entire video to maintain consistent subjects, scenes, and backgrounds throughout long-horizon generation. We also construct a high-quality training dataset of 62K video clips. To facilitate research on this underexplored problem, we introduce LVO-Bench, a benchmark curated by human experts to assess long-horizon stability and semantic consistency. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method outperforms existing approaches in both generation stability and semantic coherence.
