articles.title_zh: LongSCOP: 语法一致的长视频外绘
articles.content_zh: 视频出漆是一个重要的问题,然而现有的研究主要侧重于短片片段,而长片出漆则基本上未得到充分探讨. 将视频扩展至长视频构成重大挑战。 一个自然的解决方案是迭代出画,即逐块生成视频,但这提出了两个主要问题:生成不稳定性,甚至因相通不一致和误差积累而导致的失败,以及语义漂移在长的时间线上. 在本文中,我们提出LongSCOP,简称为"语义一致"(Semantical Conference)的长相视频出镜. 首先,我们引入了一种培训配方,其中包含平稳而稳定的长视距生成的三个组成部分:自我强制培训、潜在校正和未来参考。 除了一代人的稳定之外,我们认识到长相视频丰富的时间背景为保持语义一致性提供了宝贵的参考。 因此,我们开发了一个基于VLM的代理,自动从整个视频中选择信息最丰富的参考框架,以在长视一代中保持一致的主题,场景和背景. 我们还建造了由62K个录像片段组成的高质量培训数据集。 为了促进对这一未得到充分探讨的问题的研究,我们采用了LVO-Bench,这是由人类专家制定的基准,用于评估长相稳定性和语义一致性。 广泛的实验表明,我们的方法在生成稳定性和语义一致性方面都超过了现有方法。

articles.title: MoSTE: Mixture of Spatio-Temporal Experts for Deepfake Detection in Videos
articles.content: Generalizable deepfake video detection remains challenging because forgery artifacts vary substantially across manipulation types and often combine diverse spatial and temporal inconsistencies. Existing parameter-efficient adaptation methods typically rely on a single shared representation, rendering them prone to manipulation-specific bias and limiting transfer to unseen forgeries. To address this challenge, we propose Mixture Of Spatio-Temporal Experts (MoSTE), an adaptation framework that enables conditional specialization of forensic representations. Instead of forcing one adapter to model all forgery patterns, MoSTE decomposes adaptation into parallel spatial and temporal expert pools and dynamically routes tokens to the most relevant experts through an unsupervised token-level routing mechanism. This allows experts to naturally specialize in complementary forgery cues without requiring explicit manipulation labels or multi-stage training, while effectively transferring representations from CLIP to the video domain. Extensive experiments across cross-dataset and cross-manipulation benchmarks demonstrate that MoSTE sets a new state of the art in average generalization while preserving strong performance across diverse manipulation families. Additional analysis of expert routing and attention behavior reveals the emergence of expert diversity, suggesting that MoSTE learns complementary spatio-temporal forensic features. Code is available at https://github.com/charbelyah/MoSTE
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: MoSTE: 视频深层假象探测的空间-时空专家的混合物
articles.content_zh: 一般性的深层假象探测仍然具有挑战性,因为伪造文物在操纵类型上差别很大,而且往往将不同的空间和时间不一致结合起来。 现有参数效率高的适应方法通常依靠单一的共享代表,使其容易出现操纵性特定偏见,并将转让限制在隐形伪造行为。 为了应对这一挑战,我们提出 " 空间-时空专家混合 " (Mixture Of Spatio-Temporal Expertion,MoSTE),这是一个适应性框架,能够有条件地使法医陈述专业化。 MoSTE没有强迫一个适配器模拟所有伪造模式,而是通过一个不受监督的象征级通路机制,将适应分解为平行的时空专家集合并动态地向最相关的专家传递信号. 这使得专家可以自然地专门从事互补的伪造提示,而不需要明确的操纵标签或多阶段培训,同时有效地将表现从CLIP转移到视频领域. 跨数据集和跨操纵基准的广泛实验表明,科技部在平均概括方面设定了一个新的技术水平,同时保持了不同操纵家庭的强效性能。 对专家路线和注意力行为的其他分析揭示出专家多样性的出现,表明科技部学习了互补的斯皮提欧-时空法医学特征. 代码见https://github.com/charbelyah/MoSTE

articles.title: Occupancy Modelling of Biased Landslide Inventories: When Does Separating Occurrence from Recording Improve on Neutralisation?
articles.content: Landslide susceptibility models are trained on inventories that record where landslides were seen, not where they occurred. The established remedy fits bias-describing variables and neutralises them when mapping. We adapt occupancy-detection modelling from ecology, treating several inventories as imperfect observers of one event and separating occurrence from recording, and ask when this improves on neutralisation. We use near-complete inventories of the 2018 Hokkaido Eastern Iburi, 2015 Gorkha and 2010 Haiti earthquakes with simulated reporting bias, and three real Gorkha inventories. Compared with standard practice, the occupancy model reduces road bias in 24 of 25 paired draws and raises AUC by 0.08-0.14 on Gorkha and 0.03 on Haiti, but only 0.01-0.02 on Iburi. Its median predicted-to-true landslide rate is 0.99 (range 0.44-1.89), against 0.24-0.30 for the baselines. Rescaling the baselines with the same anchor area corrects their median but leaves larger errors (range 0.20-4.34). Cell-level probabilities remain too extreme (calibration slope 0.59). Compared with the best neutralised model, AUC is higher on Iburi (by 0.03-0.07) and lower on Gorkha and Haiti (by 0.01-0.05). Transplant experiments tie the Iburi advantage to the structure of its true landslide pattern, not to its terrain or road network. In all eight settings with a low interaction gap, computable from biased records, neutralisation was at least as accurate, including a prespecified test on Haiti; a high gap did not guarantee an advantage. The real Gorkha inventories are slope-biased, not road-biased, and there the model brings no meaningful gain. Report-based catalogues remain the main untested case.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 山区滑坡模型 清单:何时将发生情况与记录区分开来有助于中立?
articles.content_zh: 对滑坡易发性模型进行清点培训,记录滑坡发生地点,而不是发生地点。 既定的补救办法符合描述偏差的变量,并在绘图时消除了这些变量。 我们从生态学角度调整了占用-探测模型,把若干清单当作一个事件的不完善的观察者,并将发生与记录区分开来,并询问这何时可以改善中和。 我们使用2018年北海道东伊布里地震,2015年戈尔克哈地震和2010年海地地震的近乎完整的清点,模拟报告偏差,并使用3个真实的戈尔克哈清点. 与标准做法相比,入住模式减少了25对图中的24对道路偏差,使AUC在戈尔克哈和海地分别上升了0.08-0.14和0.03,但在伊布里仅上升了0.01-0.02. 其预测到真实的山体滑坡率中位数为0.99(范围为0.44-1.89),基线为0.24-0.30。 调整相同锚地的基线可以校正其中值,但留下较大误差(范围为0.20-4.34)。 细胞层概率仍然太高(校准坡度为0.59)。 与最佳中和型号相比,伊布里岛的AUC更高(比0.03-0.07),戈尔克哈和海地更低(比0.01-0.05). 移植实验将Iburi的优势与其真正的山体滑坡模式的结构联系起来,而不是与其地形或道路网挂钩. 在从有偏见的记录中推算出互动差距较小的所有8个场合中,中和至少同样准确,包括对海地进行预先规定的测试;高差距并不能保证优势. 真正的戈尔克哈存货是坡度偏差的,而不是道路偏差的,那里的模式没有带来有意义的收益. 以报告为基础的目录仍然是未经检验的主要案例。

articles.title: dNaViT: Discrete Codes are General-Purpose Visual Representations
articles.content: Discrete autoregressive modeling, notably through next-token prediction, has become a cornerstone of modern language models. Extending this paradigm to vision allows visual and language models to converge on a unified framework, thereby fostering shared methodology and infrastructure. This work investigates a central question: how far can a finite discrete vocabulary go in representing the richness of the visual world? We present dNaViT, a Discrete Native-resolution Vision Transformer that produces discrete visual primitives analogous to language tokens. Built upon a frozen pretrained encoder, dNaViT applies lightweight residual modulation with a dual-branch objective to inject reconstruction-aware cues into semantic features. By leveraging grouped product quantization, it scales discrete capacity without inflating spatial sequence lengths, while a balanced training recipe maintains both semantic and pixel-level information. Consequently, dNaViT functions as a versatile discrete visual tokenizer, enabling unified encoding across downstream tasks alongside high-fidelity image decoding. Extensive evaluations show that dNaViT matches or exceeds task-specific baselines across 12 visual understanding benchmarks, 4 generation benchmarks, and an image editing benchmark. These findings demonstrate that a compact discrete vocabulary can serve as a universal visual currency and unlock the full potential of fully unified, native multimodal methodology.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: dNaViT: 分散代码是通用视觉表现
articles.content_zh: 断断续续的自递模型,特别是通过下接的预测,已经成为现代语言模型的基石. 将这一范式扩展至视觉,可以使视觉和语言模式趋同于一个统一的框架,从而促进共享的方法和基础设施. 这部作品调查了一个中心问题:一个有限的离散词汇在代表视觉世界的丰富性方面能走多远? 我们介绍dNaViT,一种异地土著分辨率的视觉变形器,它产生类似于语言符号的离散视觉原始. dNaViT在被冷冻的预导编码器上所建,采用重量轻的剩余调制,具有双分支目标,为语义特征注入再重建-知觉提示. 通过利用被分组的产品量化,它在不夸大空间序列长度的情况下衡量离散能力,而平衡的培训配方则保持语义和像素级信息。 因此,dNaViT可以发挥多功能的离散视觉显示器的作用,在高真实度图像解码的同时,可以实现跨下游任务的统一编码。 广泛的评价表明,dNaViT在12个视觉理解基准、4个生成基准和一个图像编辑基准中匹配或超过特定任务的基线。 这些调查结果表明,紧凑的离散词汇可作为通用的可视货币,并释放充分统一、本土多式联运方法的全部潜力。

articles.title: PhysOPSD: Code as Privilege for Physically Plausible Video Generation
articles.content: While modern video generative models achieve remarkable visual fidelity, they remain noticeably brittle when generating physically plausible dynamics and complex interactions. Targeted post-training is crucial, yet supervised fine-tuning suffers from offline state mismatch, and reinforcement learning is hindered by sparse, ill-defined physical reward functions. On-Policy (Self-)Distillation (OPSD) reconciles on-policy rollouts with dense corrective feedback, shifting the core challenge to designing effective privileged context. However, conventional modalities fall short: text prompts are inherently declarative, whereas real reference videos heavily entangle physical laws with visual appearance without parametric control. To this end, we propose PhysOPSD, introducing executable code as privileged physical context for video generation. Unlike static visual observations, executable code instantiates an editable physical world with intrinsic abstraction and controllability. Powered by PhysOPSD-Engine, we translate real-world physical scenarios into verifiable simulation programs. PhysOPSD then incorporates (i) dual-level physical privilege to bridge the information gap via an intermediate bottleneck, alongside (ii) controlled physical variations under shared rollout noise to expose causal dynamic shifts. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PhysOPSD substantially improves physical plausibility across diverse backbones, outperforming SFT and RL baselines with only $3$K samples, while preserving general video generation quality.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: PhysOPSD: 物理放电视频生成的特权代码
articles.content_zh: 虽然现代视频基因模型实现了显著的视觉忠实,但在产生物理上可信的动态和复杂的相互作用时,这些模型仍然明显脆弱。 有针对性的培训后培训至关重要,但受监督的微调却受到离线状态不匹配的影响,强化学习因缺乏定义的物理奖励功能而受阻。 政策(自我)分裂(OPSD)使政策推出与密集的纠正反馈相协调,将核心挑战转向设计有效的特权环境。 然而,传统模式还很短:文本提示本身就具有宣示性,而真实的参考视频则在视觉外观上严重缠绕了物理定律,没有参数控制. 为此,我们提出PhysOPSD,引入可执行代码作为视频生成的特权物理上下文. 与静态视觉观测不同,可执行代码即时将一个具有内在抽象和可控性的可编辑物理世界. 由PhysOPSD-Engine提供动力,我们把现实世界的物理情景转化为可核查的模拟程序. PhysOPSD随后纳入了(一)通过中间瓶颈来弥补信息差距的双重物理特权,以及(二)在共享推出噪声下受控的物理变化,以暴露因果动态变化. 广泛的实验表明,物理学OPSD大大改进了不同骨干之间的物理可信度,超过了SFT和RL基线,只有$K样本,同时保持了一般的视频生成质量.

articles.title: PTC-IoU: CPU-Friendly Detection Quality Estimation for Edge Video Analytics
articles.content: An edge video analytics system must estimate the quality of local detections since there are no ground-truth labels available during runtime. Detectors usually provide confidence scores for their results, but these scores can not reveal every missed object or misplaced bounding box. So a quality estimator is necessary to provide a decision signal indicating which frame has potential detection failures that need to be escalated to a more powerful model in the cloud. Neural network based estimators add workload to the GPU already running detection, while CPU capacity may remain available. We present Predictive Temporal Consistency IoU (PTC-IoU), which moves this workload to CPU by compacting detection boxes histories to support deterministic result scoring. Comparing to neural counterparts, experiments on representative edge hardware, Nvidia Jetson Orin Nano, show that our method reduced per-frame estimator latency from 10.3 ms for neural counterparts to 2.2 ms (4.7x faster), increased pipelined throughput by 13.6%, and cuts estimator energy consumption by up to 95%, while maintaining competitive final detection quality verified on multiple datasets.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: PTC-IoU:边缘视频分析的CPU友好检测质量估计
articles.content_zh: 边缘视频分析系统必须估计本地检测的质量,因为在运行期间没有地面真实标签。 探测器通常会为其结果提供置信分数,但这些分数无法揭示出每一个被丢失的对象或错误的边框. 因此,质量估测器对于提供决策信号来说是必要的,它表明哪个帧有潜在的检测故障,需要升级为云中更强大的模型. 基于神经网络的估算器会给已经运行的GPU检测器增加工作量,而CPU能力可能仍然可用. 我们介绍预测性时间一致性IoU(PTC-IoU),它通过压缩检测箱历史,支持确定性结果分数,将工作量转移到CPU。 与神经对应物相比,关于代表性边缘硬件Nvidia Jetson Orin Nano的实验显示,我们的方法将每帧神经对应物的视距从10.3 ms降低到2.2 ms(4.7x更快),管道吞吐量增加13.6%,将视距能耗削减到95%,同时维持在多个数据集上核实的竞争性最终检测质量.

articles.title: HiVe-Mem: Interleaving Horizontal Memory Expansion and Vertical Evidence Composition for Multimodal Agents
articles.content: As multimodal agents accumulate increasingly long interaction histories, effectively retrieving and utilizing past information becomes critical for long-term interaction. Existing memory systems typically rely on semantic retrieval over compressed memories and expose predefined representations, which may miss relevant memories and overlook heterogeneous evidence needs across queries. We introduce \textbf{\hivemem}, a multimodal memory framework that interleaves \textbf{\textsc{H}}or\textbf{\textsc{i}}zontal Memory Expansion with \textbf{\textsc{Ve}}rtical Evidence Composition. For horizontal memory expansion, \hivemem organizes memory episodes into a relational graph using textual and visual anchors, expanding semantically retrieved seeds with related neighbors to recover complementary information. For vertical evidence composition, each retrieved memory retains multiple evidence forms, including compact summaries, captions, grounded visual views, raw images, and interaction history. A lightweight trainable selector independently composes an evidence subset for each retrieved memory, enabling query-adaptive utilization of heterogeneous multimodal information. This two-dimensional design jointly broadens memory coverage and adapts the evidence contributed by individual memories. Experiments across three multimodal memory benchmarks show that \hivemem consistently improves task performance across base models while reducing token consumption by about 90\% compared with the most efficient competing multimodal baselines.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: HiVe-Mem:多式联运代理人横向内存扩展和纵向证据构成
articles.content_zh: 由于多式联运代理人积累了越来越多的长期互动历史,有效检索和利用过去的信息对于长期互动至关重要。 现有的内存系统一般依靠语义检索来取出被压缩的记忆,并暴露出预先定义的表述,这些表述可能错过了相关的记忆并忽略了各种查询中的各种证据需要. 我们引入了\ textbf\ hivemem},一个交互出\ textbf\textsc{H}}or\textbf\textsc{i}}zontal的多模式内存框架 内存扩展为\ textbf\ textsc{ Ve}}rtual 证据构成。 对于横向内存扩展,\hivemem利用文字和视觉主播将内存片段组织成关系图,与相邻相邻相邻相接而扩大被精选取出种子以恢复补充信息. 对于垂直证据构成,每个取回的内存保留了多份证据形式,包括紧凑摘要,标题,有底视视图,原始图像,互动历史等. 一个轻而易举的可训练选择器独立地为每个被检索的内存组成了证据子集,从而能够对多种多式信息进行查询调整利用。 这种二维设计共同拓宽了内存的覆盖范围并调整了由个人记忆提供的证据. 跨越三个多式联运内存基准的实验表明,与最有效的竞争多式联运基线相比,\hivemem不断改善跨基准模型的任务绩效,同时将象征性消费减少约90%。

articles.title: Is Persona Generalization Predictable?
articles.content: Persona generalization occurs when fine-tuning a language model in one domain induces behavioral changes in others -- for example, the broadly unsafe behavior observed in emergent misalignment. We discover a surprising "on-the-line" phenomenon in persona generalization: in-domain and out-of-domain persona rates across various fine-tuning hyperparameters follow an approximately probit-linear relationship, and the specific probit-linear relationship is surprisingly shared even across model families and model sizes, including Qwen and Llama. Training choices that leave the set of trainable parameters unchanged, such as learning rate, weight decay, and training duration, largely move models along the same line, reducing transfer mainly by weakening in-domain learning. Changing which layers are fine-tuned, however, can change the slope. For unsafe behavior, fine-tuning only later layers yields shallower slopes, retaining strong in-domain learning while reducing out-of-domain misalignment. This "on-the-line" phenomenon unifies unexpected, isolated observations of persona generalization within a quantitative framework for predicting and controlling behavioral transfer.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 个人一般化是否可以预测?
articles.content_zh: 当一个域中语言模型的微调会诱发其他域中的行为变化——例如,在出现错位时观察到的大致不安全的行为——时,便发生人物通化. 我们发现一个令人惊讶的"上行"现象在人物通论中: 各种微调超参数的域内和域外人物率跟随一种大致的正线关系,具体的正线关系甚至在模组家庭和模型大小之间,包括Quen和Llama之间都惊人地共享. 训练选择使得一组可训练参数保持不变,如学习率,体重衰减,训练时间等,基本上将模型沿同线移动,主要通过削弱内地学习来减少转移. 然而,改变哪些地层经过微调,可以改变坡度。 对于不安全的行为,微调只有后层才会产生更浅的坡度,保留了强大的域内学习,同时减少域外错位. 这种"上行"现象统一了在预测和控制行为转移的量化框架内,对人性泛化的出乎意料,孤立的观察.

articles.title: WorkflowArena: Benchmarking Executable Workflow Orchestration in LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems
articles.content: Large language model agents are increasingly deployed as multi-agent systems rather than as a standalone model operating within a single context. Recent agent harnesses allow the model to instantiate worker agents and to author the executable workflow that coordinates them, shifting the design of system structure from developers to the model at run time. The quality of this organization therefore constitutes a distinct capability, yet existing benchmarks either measure end-to-end task completion or evaluate coordination under structures specified in advance. We formalize this capability as workflow orchestration and introduce WorkflowArena, a benchmark of 145 long-horizon tasks spanning 8 professional domains, from software engineering and formal mathematics to legal analysis and 3D production. Each task specifies an initial workspace and an integrated deliverable composed of interdependent components, which is assessed by a hidden verifier. Agents determine autonomously whether and how to delegate, and all delegation is recorded, enabling joint evaluation of deliverable quality and the organization of the underlying work. Experiments with nine models show that no single configuration performs best across all domains and that systems exhibit distinct delegation strategies: at high effort, Claude models in Claude Code invoke workflows less frequently but with larger worker groups, whereas GPT models in Codex delegate more frequently in smaller units. When the executing model is held fixed on a challenging subset of tasks, workflows authored by Claude Opus 5.5 substantially improve weaker executors, indicating that workflow organization is itself a measurable determinant of task performance.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: WorkflowArena:基于LLM的多代理系统中可执行的工作流程管弦的基准
articles.content_zh: 大型语言模型代理越来越多地作为多代理系统而不是在单一背景下运行的独立模型被部署. 近期的代理牵引使模型能够即时化工人代理,并编写协调他们的可执行工作流程,将系统结构的设计从开发者转移到运行时间的模型. 因此,本组织的质量是独特的能力,但现有的基准要么衡量最终任务完成情况,要么在事先指定的结构下评价协调情况。 我们把这种能力正规化为工作流程的管弦乐,并引入了WorkflowArena,这是跨越8个专业领域的145个长视野任务的基准,从软件工程和正规数学到法律分析和3D制作. 每项任务都规定一个初始工作空间和一个由相互依存部分组成的综合交付品,由隐藏核查员评估。 代理人自主确定是否和如何授权,并记录所有授权,以便能够联合评价交付品质量和基本工作安排。 使用9个模型的实验表明,没有一个单一的配置在所有领域都表现得最好,而且系统表现出不同的授权战略: Claude Code中的克洛德模型引用工作流程的次数较少,但使用较大的工人群体,而Codex中的GPT模型则更频繁地在更小的单位中进行代理. 当执行模式被固定在一个具有挑战性的任务子集上时,由克洛德·奥普斯·5.5所撰写的工作流程大大改进了较弱的执行者,表明工作流程组织本身是任务绩效的可衡量决定因素.

articles.title: How Well Does AI Peer Review Work? A Benchmark Built from 100 Planted Errors
articles.content: One hundred known errors were planted into 10 open-access psychology papers, and the modified papers were then run through frontier models and two commercial AI review tools. The best single system caught 71 of the 100 errors, while the worst caught 30. Pooling every system's output caught 93. Models are only partly correlated in the errors they find, which makes ensembling a big lever for finding issues in papers. Seven errors could not be caught by any system, and all seven were omissions: information deleted from a paper rather than mistakes inserted into it. Refine.ink contributes more unique catches than any other single system, though it is expensive on a per-error basis. False positives were not measured, and how this error distribution compares to the distribution of errors in real papers remains unknown. The papers, errors, model outputs, and full experiment log are public, so that others can build on this toward a comprehensive evaluation benchmark across disciplines.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: AI同行评审工作如何? 由100起人为错误建立的基准
articles.content_zh: 一百个已知错误被植入了10个开放获取的心理学论文中,修改后的文件随后通过前沿模型和两个商业AI审查工具运行. 最佳单人系统在100个出错中抓住了71个,而最差的则抓住了30个. 把每个系统的产出都集中到93号 模型在发现的错误中只是部分相关联的,这使得共同发现文件问题成为了一大杠杆。 任何系统都无法发现7个错误,所有7个错误都是遗漏:从文件中删除信息而不是插入错误。 与任何其他单一系统相比,Fine.ink贡献了更独特的渔获量,尽管每只渔获量昂贵。 假阳性没有被测量,这种出错分布与真纸出错分布的对比仍然未知. 论文、错误、模型输出和完整的实验日志都是公开的,以便其他人能够在此基础上朝着一个跨学科的综合评价基准迈进。

articles.title: Curbside Chatbots: Auditing the Mental Health Interventions Large Language Models Recommend to Clinicians, Caregivers, and Patients
articles.content: Users are asking language models mental health questions and are receiving answers. We audited what 41 language models recommend to users when the same clinical information reaches them from three footings: a clinician describing a patient, a caregiver describing a loved one, or a person describing themselves. Across 19 case vignettes and five questions, we collected 35,055 free-text responses, extracted every intervention named with a validated judge, and had 29 models rate the full option lists on a seven-point Likert scale for the same cases. Models largely recommend what they rate well, with recommendation behavior differing by footing, and many models offering clinicians a consultation-style response and lay users hedged, simplified advice. When asked about recommendations for a specific intervention type, models more often named options they themselves rated below zero as initial choices, usually with conditions attached. We will release the instrument, code, and full corpus on publication as a living audit.

articles.title_zh: Curbside Chatbots:审计向临床医生、护理者和病人推荐的大语言模型的心理健康干预
articles.content_zh: 用户正在询问语言模型心理健康问题,并得到了答案。 我们审核了41种语言模型向用户推荐的内容, 当同样的临床信息从三个方面传到他们:一个临床医生描述病人,一个护理者描述被爱的人,或者一个自我描述的人。 在19个案件和5个问题中,我们收集了35,055份自由文本答复,提取了每个由经认证的法官命名的干预,并且有29个模型在相同案件的7分Irikrt比例上对完整选项清单进行评分。 模型主要建议如何评分,建议行为因基础不同而不同,许多模型为临床医生提供一种咨询式的响应,以及非专业用户进行套期,简化的建议. 当被问及关于特定干预类型的建议时,模型更经常地命名出它们自己被评为零以下的选项作为初始选择,通常附带条件. 我们将公布有关出版的仪器、密码和全书作为活的审计。

articles.title: Large Language Models as a Universal Searcher for Open-World Automated Machine Learning
articles.content: Developing effective machine learning models requires complex manual tuning, while current Automated Machine Learning (AutoML) frameworks remain domain-specific and isolate model architecture, training hyperparameter, and data ratio optimization. Here, we bridge this gap by proposing a universal, large language model (LLM)-based AutoML framework that jointly optimizes these configurations for the first time without the need for task-specific fine-tuning. We propose NCode, a unified numerical encoding scheme that translates diverse AutoML design choices into universal discrete sequences and effectively reframes the optimization process as a unified ranking task. Trained solely on optimization trajectories derived from a limited, single-domain vision task, the proposed LLM-based searcher demonstrates impressive cross-task, cross-modality and joint search-space optimization generalizability, achieving state-of-the-art performance across image classification, image segmentation, speaker verification and text-to-image benchmarks. Crucially, it exhibits superior scalability in the large-scale training and joint optimization of a billion-parameter Diffusion Transformer, requiring 896 GPU-days and attaining a state-of-the-art GenEval score of 0.91. By leveraging reinforcement learning to instill Chain-of-Thought reasoning, we provide a systematic way to interpret the LLM-based searcher's internal decision-making mechanisms, revealing its optimization strategy shifted from the early-stage diversity-driven exploration to the late-stage anchor exploitation. Our proposed framework provides a scalable, generalizable, and interpretable pathway toward general-purpose open-world machine learning optimization.

articles.title_zh: 大语言模型作为开放世界自动化机器学习的通用搜索器
articles.content_zh: 开发有效的机器学习模型需要复杂的人工调试,而目前的自动机器学习(AutoML)框架仍然是专有域并隔离模型架构,训练超参数,以及数据比优化. 在这里,我们通过提出一个通用的,基于大语言模型(LLM)的AutoML框架来弥补这一差距,这个框架将首次联合优化这些配置,而不需要针对特定任务的微调. 我们提出Ncode,一种统一的数字编码方案,将不同的AutoML设计选择转化为通用的离散序列,并有效地将优化过程重新设定为统一的排序任务. 拟议的基于LLM的搜索器仅就有限、单一领域愿景任务的优化轨迹进行了培训,展示了令人印象深刻的跨任务、跨模式和联合搜索-空间优化通用性,实现了跨图像分类、图像分解、语音核查和文本对图像基准的最先进性能。 关键是,它在大规模培训和联合优化十亿参数分解变压器时表现出了优异的可伸缩性,需要896个GPU日并达到最先进的GenEval分数0.91分. 通过利用强化学习来灌输思维链推理,我们提供了一种系统的方法来解释基于LLM的搜索者内部决策机制,揭示其优化战略从早期由多样性驱动的探索转向后期锚地开发. 我们拟议的框架提供了一个可扩展、可概括和可解释的途径,实现通用开放世界机器学习的优化。

articles.title: PORT: Preference Optimization via Robust Token-Level Reweighting
articles.content: Preference optimization has become a central approach for aligning large language models with human values, but its effectiveness depends heavily on the quality of preference annotations. In practice, preference data is often noisy due to annotation errors and ambiguity. Existing robust preference optimization methods primarily operate at the sequence level, implicitly treating entire responses as uniformly correct or incorrect. However, rejected responses may still contain informative reasoning steps, while preferred responses can include subtle errors. In this work, we propose \textbf{P}reference \textbf{O}ptimization via \textbf{R}obust \textbf{T}oken-level reweighting \textbf{(PORT)}, a fine-grained framework for robust alignment under noisy preferences. PORT performs token-level reweighting using the empirical cumulative distribution function (CDF) of token log-probabilities, yielding an efficient forward-pass-only proxy to gradient-norm penalization that selectively suppresses corrupted tokens without additional backward-pass computation. We provide theoretical analysis showing that PORT reduces the gradient bias from noisy preference labels by minimizing an upper bound on the bias term. Extensive experiments across diverse noise settings demonstrate that PORT consistently improves robustness and outperforms existing sequence-level baselines. The code is available at https://github.com/osu-srml/PORT

articles.title_zh: PORT:通过强力托肯级再加权优化优先级
articles.content_zh: 偏好优化已成为将大型语言模型与人类价值观相配合的核心方法,但其有效性在很大程度上取决于偏好说明的质量. 在实践中,由于注释错误和含糊不清,偏好数据往往很吵. 现有的强力偏好优化方法主要在序列层面运作,含蓄地将整个响应都视为统一正确或不正确. 然而,被拒绝的答复可能仍然包含内容丰富的推理步骤,而首选的答复可能包括微妙的错误。 在这项工作中,我们提出\textbf{P} 首选\textbf{O} 通过\textbf{R} obust\textbf{T} 重新加权\textbf{(PORT)} , 一个在吵闹的首选下强力对齐的精细框架 。 PORT利用符号日志概率的实证累积分配函数(CDF)进行符号级再加权,从而产生高效的只通过前行的代名词来进行梯度-规范惩罚,有选择地压制被腐蚀的符号而不进行额外的后行计算. 我们提供理论分析,表明PORT通过将偏好词上方的束缚最小化,从而从吵闹的偏好标签中减少梯度偏好. 不同噪音环境的广泛实验表明,PORT不断改进稳健性并超越现有序列级基线。 该代码可在https://github.com/osu-srml/PORT上查阅。

articles.title: The Narrative Gap: Can LLMs Help Us Navigate Diverse Narratives Across Languages?
articles.content: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly mediate how people seek and consume information, including accounts that differ across languages and regions, especially on contested topics. Supporting diverse information seeking requires models to help users navigate competing narratives across languages and information streams. We define six capabilities necessary for diverse multilingual information seeking: three foundational capabilities for narrative inclusion, narrative exclusion, and missing narrative identification; and three higher-level capabilities for presenting diverse narratives, preserving narrative coverage under confirmatory queries, and maintaining information parity across languages. To guide the development of those information seeking capabilities, we introduce \textsc{NarrativeBench}, a benchmark comprising 1,333 news articles in 23 publication languages across 23 contested topics and 460 Reddit-grounded queries. Evaluating 14 LLMs across 24 query languages, we find that current models lack the capabilities needed to reliably navigate diverse narratives, limiting users' control over the perspectives they receive and leaving substantial gaps in exposure to competing accounts even when diversity is explicitly requested. Information access also differs across query framings and languages, risking echo chambers, linguistic filter bubbles, and information disparities that weaken the common ground needed for democratic discourse. \textsc{NarrativeBench} provides a foundation for developing information systems that give users across languages and regions agency to navigate diverse narratives.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 描述性差距: LLMS 能否帮助我们导航跨语言的多元描述?.
articles.content_zh: 大型语言模型(LLMs)越来越多地调解人们如何寻找和消费信息,包括不同语言和地区不同的说法,特别是在有争议的议题上. 支持寻求各种信息的模型需要帮助用户浏览各种语言和信息流之间相互竞争的叙述。 我们界定了寻求多种语文信息所需的6个能力:三个基本能力,用于叙述性包容、叙述性排斥和缺少叙述性识别;三个高级能力,用于提出各种叙述,在确认性询问中保留叙述性报道,并保持各语文之间的信息平等。 为了指导这些寻求能力的信息的发展,我们采用了\textsc{Narrative Bench}这一基准包括23个有争议主题的23个出版物语言的1 333篇新闻文章和460个基于Reddit的查询。 评估24种查询语言的14种LLM,我们发现,目前的模型缺乏可靠地浏览各种叙事所需的能力,限制了用户对其所获观点的控制,即使在明确要求多样性的情况下,在接触相互竞争的账户方面也留下了很大差距。 信息获取方式也因查询框架和语言不同而不同,冒着回声室、语言过滤泡沫以及信息差异的风险,从而削弱了民主对话所需的共同点。 \textsc{Narrative Bench}为开发信息系统提供了基础,使不同语言和地区机构的用户能够浏览不同的叙述。

articles.title: Safe Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Turn Clinical Agents: When Dense Rewards Beat Outcome Rewards
articles.content: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards is increasingly used to improve language model reasoning, yet its effects on sequential decision procedures remain poorly understood. We study this problem in clinical multi-turn agents that must decide what information to request, when to stop gathering evidence, and which action to take. We introduce three controlled environments: medication refill triage, acute diagnostic work-up, and dosing titration, each with hidden clinical states, query costs, exact adaptive oracles, and deterministic outcome verifiers. Across these tasks, outcome-only group relative policy optimization often improves aggregate reward while producing undesirable procedures, including premature commitment, one-question collapse, and failures on rare high-risk cases. In diagnostics, assigning dense credit to questions that reduce uncertainty improves held-out value and moderate-case support across three training seeds relative to outcome-only reinforcement learning, without the high-risk seed collapse observed under outcome-only training. Separating exploration from exploitation further increases high-risk support at its best checkpoint, but at the cost of excessive information gathering on low-acuity cases. Additional experiments show that the optimal strength of process credit is task-dependent; that after a supervised warmup that already gathers carefully, reinforcement learning raises aggregate reward by trimming questions while degrading high-risk performance; and that reinforcement learning does not reliably repair rare behavior gaps inherited from biased supervised data. Verifiable final outcomes are therefore insufficient for training reliable multi-turn agents: reward design must account for the procedure used to reach an answer, and evaluation must distinguish adaptive information gathering from reward-exploiting shortcuts.

articles.title_zh: 多轮诊疗人员的安全强化学习:当感应奖励 优等结果奖励
articles.content_zh: 以可核查的奖励加强学习越来越多地用于改进语言模式推理,但这种学习对顺序决定程序的影响仍然缺乏了解。 我们在临床多转子制剂中研究这个问题,这些制剂必须决定要求什么信息,何时停止收集证据,以及采取何种行动. 我们引入了三种可控制的环境:药物再填充分解,急性诊断工作,和给乳量, 每一个都有隐藏的临床状态,查询成本,精确的适应性甲骨文,以及确定性结果的验证器。 在整个这些任务中,只注重结果的集团相对政策优化往往会改善总的奖励,同时产生不良的程序,包括过早承诺、一个问题倒闭和在少数高风险案件中失败。 在诊断方面,对减少不确定性的问题给予密集的信贷,可以提高三个培训种子在只注重结果的强化学习方面的持有价值和中度支持,而不会出现只在注重结果的培训下观察到的高风险种子倒闭。 将勘探与开采分开,进一步增加了在最佳检查站的高风险支助,但代价是收集过多关于低清晰度案件的信息。 额外的实验表明,过程信用的最佳强度取决于任务;在经过已经认真收集的有监督的热量后,强化学习通过修饰问题而降低高风险性能而提高总的回报;强化学习并不能可靠地修复从有偏见的有监督的数据中继承下来的罕见行为漏洞. 因此,可核实的最终结果不足以培训可靠的多回合代理商:奖励设计必须顾及用于获得答案的程序,评价必须区分适应信息收集与奖励-探索捷径。

articles.title: A local language model layered with rule-based and neural detectors for clinical text de-identification: an open-source toolkit and evaluation
articles.content:
Objectives: To measure whether a locally hosted large language model (LLM), stacked with deterministic and clinical named-entity recognition (NER) detectors, finds more protected health information (PHI) than open tools, and at what precision.
  Materials and Methods: DeidSharp, an open-source .NET toolkit, combines the findings of pluggable detectors (patterns, a clinical NER model, a local 26B mixture-of-experts LLM) and fails closed on any detector error. Configurations fixed on tuning halves were compared, under a prespecified protocol, with deid, Philter, the Stanford/Penn de-identifier, OpenAI Privacy Filter and GLiNER on reporting halves of PhysioNet's nursing notes (889 spans) and semi-synthetic MIMIC-IV-Note discharge summaries (29,023 spans), and on synthetic ASQ-PHI queries, with paired patient-level bootstrap intervals.
  Results: In the nursing notes, against Stanford/Penn, the recall-first stack found 98.9% of PHI (+2.8, 95% CI 1.4 to 4.4) at 9.3 points lower precision; the precision-first stack, without NER, found 96.5%, matching Stanford/Penn, at 19.6 points higher precision (83.2%). In the discharge summaries, both stacks led Stanford/Penn by more than 20 points (recall-first 95.3%, +21.5, 20.5 to 22.4), almost entirely on generated untyped names; on typed labels all three exceeded 99%. All four prespecified comparisons held. No configuration beat deid significantly on its home corpus; Philter found more discharge-summary spans than the recall-first stack at 23 points lower precision.
  Discussion: The LLM was the main detector and NER added place names; asked to verify its own findings, the LLM discarded a quarter of true PHI.
  Conclusion: A local LLM layered with deterministic detectors offers recall-first and precision-first operating points without sending text off-site.

articles.title_zh: 一个以规则和神经探测器为分层的当地语言模型,用于临床文本去识别:一个开源工具包和评价
articles.content_zh:
目标: 为了衡量当地托管的大型语言模型(LLM)是否配有决定性的和临床的命名实体识别(NER)探测器,发现了比开放式工具更受保护的健康信息(PHI),以及何种精度.
材料与方法:DeidSharp,开源. NET工具包,结合了可插接探测器(patters,一种临床NER模型,一种本地的26B型专家混合LLM)的发现,并因任何探测器出错而失效. 根据预先规定的协议,将固定在调制分身上的配置与Deid、Philter、Stanford/Penn去识别器、OpenAI隐私过滤器和GLinER进行比较,以报告PhysioNet的护理笔记(889个跨度)和半合成MIIC-IV-Note排放摘要(29,023个跨度),以及合成ASQ-PHI查询,并配对病人级的靴子间隔。
结果: 在护理笔记中,针对斯坦福/彭恩,召回第一堆在9.3分更低的精度上发现了98.9%的PHI (+2.8,95% CI 1.4至4.4);精度第一堆在没有NER的情况下,发现了96.5%,与斯坦福/彭恩相匹配,在19.6分更高的精度上(83.2%). 在放出简况中,两堆都使斯坦福/平分超过20分(召回前95.3%,+21.5,20.5至22.4),几乎完全依靠生成的无型名;打入的标签上,全部3分都超过了99%. 所有四个预先规定的比较都进行了。 其家用装置上没有显著的配置跳动;菲尔特发现排出-总结跨度比23分更低精度的回放-第一堆要多.
讨论: LLM是主要的探测器,NER增加了地名;为了验证自己的发现,LLM抛弃了四分之一真实的PHI.
结论: 本地LLM分层有确定探测器,提供回溯第一和精度第一的操作点,而不向外发送文本.

articles.title: A Lattice-Based HMM Approach to Aruz Scansion of Ottoman Poetry
articles.content: Ottoman Divan poetry is composed in aruz, a quantitative meter based on the weights of syllables. The meter is sensitive to specific characters recorded in the original writing in the Arabic script. This work is concerned with automatic meter finding and scansion alignment for Ottoman Divan poetry, especially on modern Turkish spelling without the special diacritics that scholarly transliterations of Ottoman preserve. We define two tasks on this input, first identifying the meter used in the poem, and second aligning the meter's weights with the syllabification of the poem, identifying the flaws and freedoms the poet has taken along the way. We build a corpus of 52,000 lines split by poet, with scansion annotations for 500 test lines, and a robustness benchmark generated at the deviation rates measured on real web and OCR copies. Our model is a hidden Markov model over the positions of each meter, decoded over a lattice of every candidate path, and trained by EM from the printed meter, without scansion labels. On a held-out set it scans 77.6% of the test lines fully correctly, against 26.8% for the available rule-based scanner, 55.0% for a neural tagger trained with the same supervision and 63.6% for Claude Opus 5.5 few-shot. The code is open-sourced and the tool is released on the web.

articles.title_zh: 一种基于Lattice的 HMM 方法来扫描奥斯曼诗
articles.content_zh: 奥斯曼·迪万诗歌由aruz所组成,根据音节的分量而成的定量表. 该仪表对阿拉伯文正文中原作所记录的特定字符很敏感. 这部作品涉及奥斯曼第凡诗歌的自动仪表查找和扫描对接,特别是在现代土耳其语拼写上,没有奥托曼学术转写所保存的特殊二甲词. 我们在这个投入上定义了两个任务,首先确定诗中使用的分量表,第二,将分量表的分量与诗作的分量相配合,确定诗人沿途采取的缺点和自由. 我们建造了一套由诗人分裂的52,000行, 并附有500条测试线的扫描说明, 以及一个以真实网络和OCR拷贝量测得的偏差率计算的强健性基准。 我们的模型是一个隐藏的马可夫模型, 覆盖每个公尺的位置, 解码在每一个候选路径的一叠上, 由EM从打印公尺训练, 没有扫描标签。 在停放时,它扫描了77.6%的测试线,完全正确,而现有的基于规则的扫描仪扫描率为26.8%,接受过同样监督的神经标记仪扫描率为55.0%,克劳德·奥普斯扫描率为63.6%。 代码是开源的,工具在网络上发布.

articles.title: TrialDesignBench: Benchmarking Language Models for Phase-I Trial Design Against Clinical Knowledge
articles.content: AI is used in much of the clinical trial pipeline. However, selecting the statistical design of a trial, a crucial step that determines how drug doses are tested on humans and evaluated, has seen almost no AI progress. LLMs appear to be a natural fit given their strengths in biomedical knowledge and statistical reasoning. Nevertheless, there is currently no appropriate way to evaluate such abilities because recent regulatory and methodological shifts, most notably FDA's Project Optimus, have redefined what constitutes a reasonable design and rendered many previous designs obsolete. To lay the groundwork for AI-assisted trial design, we introduce TrialDesignBench, a benchmark of 617 Phase-I/I-II oncology dose-finding trials, each paired with an expert-validated reference design that is consistent with the latest FDA regulatory initiatives. This reference standard is produced through a formalization of the expert design process. We evaluate five frontier LLMs, none of which matches the reference standard. Our ablation experiments trace this performance gap to two main causes, inference of latent, unrecorded design determinants from trial sources (supplying them raises class-wise balanced accuracy by 0.22) and structured decision-tree reasoning (+0.24). TrialDesignBench offers a reproducible, contemporary-standard objective for evaluating and enhancing AI-assisted trial design.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Bench审判设计:对照临床知识为第一阶段审判设计制定基准语言模型
articles.content_zh: AI被用于大部分临床试验管道. 然而,选择试验的统计设计是决定如何对人体进行药物剂量测试和评估的关键步骤,但几乎没有AI的进展. 鉴于LLMS在生物医学知识和统计推理方面的长处,LLMS似乎是自然适合的. 然而,目前没有适当的方法来评价这种能力,因为最近的监管和方法变化,最著名的是林业发展局的Optimus项目,重新界定了构成合理设计的内容,并使以前的许多设计过时。 为了为人工智能协助的试验设计打下基础,我们引入了TrialDesign Bench,该基准为617个一/一-二阶段肿瘤剂量测定试验,每个试验都配有符合林业发展局最新监管举措的专家认证参考设计。 这一参考标准是通过专家设计过程的正规化制定的。 我们评价了五个前沿有限责任公司,没有一个符合参考标准。 我们的通化实验将这一性能差距追溯到两个主要原因:从试验来源推断潜在的、没有记录的设计决定因素(提供这些要素可提高0.22的阶级平衡准确性)和结构化的决策树推理(+0.24)。 TrialDesign Bench为评价和增强AI辅助试验设计提供了一个可复制的,当代的标准目标.

articles.title: How Far Does Second-Order Linear Response Predict Quantization Mismatch? Pre-Registered Measurements on Five Language Models
articles.content: Serving systems choose a weight format for each model and deployment. A low-cost screen predicts the resulting KL divergence from the unquantized model's Fisher information using $\tfrac12Δ^\top FΔ$, the expansion underlying Hessian-aware and second-order post-training quantizers. We assess the reliability of this screen in GPU batches with channel-wise int8, per-tensor fp8 and group-wise int4 on Qwen3-8B, Qwen3-4B, OLMo-2-7B, Qwen3-32B and Qwen3-30B-A3B. Relative predictions hold across a 16-fold range of perturbation scales, int4 group sizes and rounding modes, while absolute predictions are heavy-tailed. A trimmed average brings 10 of 12 cells on Qwen3-4B and OLMo-2 within 15% of measured KL. The MoE model exhibits nonquadratic response at small perturbations, with int8 KL scaling as $α^{0.63}$. Computing per-sequence gradients in bf16 can cause fourfold prediction errors. We trace these errors to arithmetic in the lower half of the backward pass and eliminate them by using fp32 there. Batch-invariant kernels run at 0.55 times the throughput, while changes in reduction order introduce a floor of 0.17-0.22 nats per sequence. We build a screener with one streamed fp32 Fisher pass, trimmed tensor-block predictions with a band, a flag for aligned tensors and per-layer format allocation. On the unseen Mistral-7B-v0.3 family, all six predictions fall within the band, all three KL budgets are met, and vLLM throughput is predicted within 0.4%.

articles.title: Adapting Small Language Models to Romanized Nepali: Tokenizer Fertility, Reference Likelihood, and Generation Metrics
articles.content: Romanized Nepali, Nepali written in Latin script, is common in digital communication but has no standard spelling and few resources, and it is unclear how reliably small open language models can be adapted to it. We adapt three 2-3B base models from different families, Llama-3.2-3B, Qwen2.5-3B, and Gemma-2-2B, with QLoRA on 9,000 instruction examples produced by deterministic transliteration of Nepali instruction data. Each model is trained with one shared recipe and three seeds and evaluated on 1,000 held-out examples with reference-overlap metrics, byte-normalized reference likelihood (bits per byte, BPB), and an output audit, against zero-shot baselines under two prompts. Fine-tuning raises chrF++ from 10-14 to 29.0-30.6 and lowers BPB from 2.23-2.41 to 0.78-0.84; most zero-shot outputs (54-92%) are English-like. Likelihood and overlap disagree on how far apart the models are. Llama-3.2-3B has the lowest BPB in every seed, 0.042 below Qwen2.5-3B (95% CI 0.039-0.046), yet the two cannot be separated on chrF++ (30.51 and 30.61) or BLEU, even with paired item-level tests. Gemma-2-2B, whose tokenizer splits Romanized Nepali words least (2.72 tokens per word), scores worst on every measure. Which model gains most over its zero-shot baseline depends on the zero-shot prompt. In a supplementary comparison with an identical tokenizer, Llama-3.1-8B lowers BPB by 0.053 (0.050-0.056) relative to Llama-3.2-3B, while chrF++ and BLEU rise by only 0.68 and 0.58 points. Lower fertility and higher reference likelihood therefore did not identify the model whose outputs were closest to the references.

articles.title: Type-logical grammars and formal languages
articles.content: We show that type-logical grammars with the standard rules for product, associativity, extraction and infixation have an NP-complete fixed recognition problem, adapting a construction for first-order linear logic from Pshenitsyn (2025), who already showed that grammars in first-order linear logic are closed under intersection and therefore not semilinear and not mildly context-sensitive. We strengthen these results and shown that grammars in first-order linear logic can simulate the quasi-linear grammars of Book \& Greibach (1970), the grammars recognised in non-deterministic linear time (NSPACE(n) or. NLIN). I argue that NLIN is an interesting class of formal languages as well, and a useful upper bound on the time complexity of formalisms used for natural language, just like LOGCFL is a useful upper bound on the space complexity. Taken together this means that first-order linear logic can be seen as the logic of non-deterministic linear-time string languages, graph languages and automata.

articles.title_zh: 类型逻辑语法和正式语言
articles.content_zh: 我们显示,具有产品标准规则的类逻辑语法,相接性,取入和相接性都有NP完全的固定识别问题,从Pshenitsyn(2025年)调整出一阶线性逻辑的构造,后者已经表明一阶线性逻辑的语法在相交下是封闭的,因此没有半线性,也没有温和上下文敏感. 我们强化这些结果,并表明一阶线性逻辑中的语法可以模拟Book QQ Greibach (1970)的准线性语法,即非定型线性时间(NSPACE (n) 或. NLIN)中公认的语法. 我主张NLIN也是一门有趣的正式语言类,对于自然语言所使用的形式主义的时间复杂性来说,一个有用的上限,就像LOGCFL一样,是空间复杂性上限的一个有用的上限. 综合起来,这意味着一阶线性逻辑可以被看作非定型线性时字符串语言,图表语言和自動相通的逻辑.

articles.title: Unmasking Four Knapsack Problems in the Traveling Thief Benchmark
articles.content: The traveling thief problem (TTP) asks a thief to choose a tour and a packing together, and the benchmark of 9,720 instances of Polyakovskiy et al. (2014) is the standard test set for comparing TTP heuristics. We show that four of these instances are not TTP instances at all. Their files give a renting rate of 0.00, so the tour has no effect on the objective and each instance reduces to a 0-1 knapsack problem. One of them belongs to the 60 categorized instances on which new methods are usually compared, and on it five of nine published methods report exactly the same value. The cause is the format of the files, which keep the renting rate with two decimals, while the rule of the generator gives a rate close to 0.003 on these instances. The same rounding may shift the rate of 949 other instances by more than 1%. Since the tour and the packing used by the generator were not published, the original rates cannot be recovered. We therefore define new rates with the same rule, applied to a fully specified reference solution that we publish, and we show with a published heuristic that the corrected instances behave as TTP instances again. We also give reference results on the corrected instances and recommendations for future studies. Finally, we present ttplib, a new open-source Python library that loads any of the 9,720 instances, including the corrected ones, without downloading the whole benchmark.

articles.title_zh: 在旅行小偷基准中揭开四个背包问题
articles.content_zh: 出行的小偷问题(TTP)要求小偷选择巡演和包装在一起,9,720例Polyakovskiy等人(2014年)的基准是比较TTPheuristics的标准测试设定. 我们显示,其中4起根本不是TP案件。 他们的档案给出了0.00的租借率,因此巡演对目标没有影响,每个实例都会降低到0-1克纳帕克问题. 其中一种属于通常比较新方法的60个分类例子,9个公布方法中有5个报告的价值完全相同。 原因是文件的格式,它使租入率保持了两个小数,而生成器的规则则给出了近于0.003的租入率. 相同的四舍五入可能使949起其他案件的比率改变1%以上。 由于出行和发电机使用的包装没有公布,所以无法收回原始费率。 因此,我们用同样的规则来定义新的费率,适用于我们公布的完全指定的参考解决方案,我们用一个已公布的欣快论来表明,纠正的事例再次表现为TP实例。 我们还就纠正的案例提供参考结果,并提出建议供今后研究。 最后,我们提出 ttplib,这是一个新的开源 Python 库,可以加载9,720个实例中的任何一个,包括被更正的事例,而不下载整个基准.

articles.title: Fairness in Explainable AI Narratives: Decomposing Social Disparities in LLM-Generated Explanations
articles.content: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to translate technical explainable AI (XAI) artefacts such as SHAP into explanatory narratives (XAINs) for lay users. In high-risk domains, these explanations are often the main resource through which individuals can understand and contest adverse decisions. Yet LLMs are known to reproduce social bias, even from proxy variables alone, and fairness in XAINs remains unstudied. Because XAINs are bound to a ground-truth artefact, fairness concerns not only what a narrative says and how, but also whether it is equally faithful across social groups. We introduce fairness in XAINs as a new field of research and propose a framework that generates narratives under three conditions (protected attribute disclosed, withheld, or counterfactually swapped), allowing five comparisons that pinpoint the cause of disparities. We apply it to adversely classified instances from four datasets in credit scoring, education and employment, generating narratives with five LLMs, and evaluate faithfulness, feature coverage and sentiment. We find significant disparities across all datasets, metric families and models, arising in two ways. Faithfulness disparities result from feature values: LLMs make plausible but false statements, triggered by values that are unequally distributed across social groups. Feature coverage and sentiment disparities stem from the protected attribute itself: once it is disclosed, LLMs give less explanation to, or frame more negatively the narratives of, groups that have historically been discriminated against or are stereotypically associated with worse outcomes. A more faithful model removes the faithfulness disparities, and withholding protected attributes mostly removes the others, but neither suffices on its own. Fairness in XAINs should therefore be audited separately from the predictive model and its XAI artefact.

articles.title_zh: 解释性AI描述中的公平性:在LLM-Genered解释中的社会差异
articles.content_zh: 大语言模型(LLMs)被越来越多地用于将SHAP等技术可解释的AI(XAI)手工艺品翻译为非专业用户的解释性叙事(XAINs). 在高风险领域,这些解释往往是个人了解和质疑不利决定的主要资源。 然而,LLMS已知会复制社会偏见,甚至仅从代理变量中产生,而XAINs中的公平性仍未被研究. 因为XAINs与地心真言相接,公平不仅涉及叙述的内容和方式,还涉及它是否同样忠实于各社会群体。 我们引入了XAINs中的公平性,作为一个新的研究领域,并提出了一个框架,在三个条件下产生叙述(受保护的属性被披露,被扣留,或被反向交换),允许进行五个比较,找出差异的原因. 我们将其应用于信贷评分、教育和就业方面的四个数据集中的不利分类情况,生成有五个有限责任公司的说明,并评价忠诚程度、特征覆盖面和情绪。 我们发现,所有数据集、计量家庭和模型存在重大差异,有两种方式。 信仰差异源于特征价值: LLMS作出可信而虚假的言论,这些言论是由不同社会群体不平等分配的价值观所引发的。 特征覆盖和情绪差异源于受保护的属性本身:一旦披露,法学硕士对历来受到歧视或与更恶劣的结果有定型关系的群体的描述作出较少的解释或描述更为负面。 一个更忠实的模型消除了忠诚的悬殊,而扣取被保护的属性大多去除其他的属性,但两者都不足以单独解决. 因此,XAINs中的公平性应与预测模型及其XAI活性分开审计。

articles.title: AgentOPSD: Turn-Level Credit Assignment via Recursive Belief Revision
articles.content: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards ordinarily spreads a single advantage over a whole trajectory, a granularity too coarse to isolate the few decisions on which success in a long, multi-turn interaction actually turns. Privileged self-distillation supplies denser supervision, but it leaves unanswered how a set of local teacher-student discrepancies should be converted into credit along a sequence. We introduce AgentOPSD, a critic-free scheme that assigns credit recursively, one interaction turn at a time. Inside a turn, the token-level log-probability gaps between a skill-conditioned self-teacher and the student are summed, and that sum acts as evidence in a recursive Bayesian update carried out in log-odds space; the resulting revisions reallocate the outcome-derived advantage across turns through a multiplier that is bounded and preserves its sign. With Qwen2.5-3B and Qwen2.5-7B as policy backbones on ALFWorld, the method improves consistently on GRPO and on self-distillation baselines, and attains 89.1% success at the 7B scale. Ablations attribute the gain to aggregating evidence at turn boundaries and to making the belief revision depend on history, rather than to the local gap by itself.

articles.title_zh: 代理OPSD:通过 递归性信仰修订
articles.content_zh: 用可核查的奖励加强学习通常将单一优势分布在整个轨迹上,颗粒性过于粗糙,无法孤立在长期、多回合互动中真正取得成功的少数决定。 私人的自我消化提供了更密集的监管,但是,对于如何按照顺序将一系列当地师生差异转换成信贷,却没有答案。 我们引入了AgentOPSD, 一个无批评性的计划, 递归地分配信用, 一次一个交互转折。 反过来,技能条件好的自学教师与学生之间的象征性对数概率差距被归纳,总和在对数空间进行的巴耶斯语递归更新中起到证据作用;由此产生的修订通过一个限定并保持其标志的乘数,将结果产生的优势重新分配。 以Quen2.5-3B和Quen2.5-7B作为ALFWorld的政策支柱,该方法在GRPO和自毁基准上不断改进,在7B规模上取得了89.1%的成功. 偏差将收益归结为在转弯边界汇集证据,使信仰修正取决于历史,而不是地方差距本身。

articles.title: Evaluating Cross-Signal Coherence in Mammography Vision-Language Models
articles.content: As vision-language models (VLMs) move toward interpreting medical images directly, their outputs increasingly include not just a label but a stated confidence and a written justification. Yet the field still predominantly evaluates VLMs using just accuracy. We evaluate the coherence between answer, confidence, and explanation across four VLMs on breast density and BI-RADS categorization, using two mammography datasets. We perform controlled perturbations of the question, multiple choice option orders, and the images and assess changes in the three outputs. Our results suggest confidence does not decrease even as the mammography image is changed. Shuffling the options also changes most VLMs' answers. Notably, there are cases where a model's own stated reasoning contradicts its final answer, a distinction accuracy alone cannot capture but one that governs whether an AI-generated answer can be trusted.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 评价乳房外观-语言模型的跨部门一致性
articles.content_zh: 随着视觉语言模型(VLMs)向直接解释医疗图像的方向发展,其产出越来越多地不仅包括一个标签,而且包括一个声明的信心和书面理由。 然而,这个领域仍然主要使用准确性来评估自愿酰胺。 我们利用两个乳房X线照相数据集,评估四个关于乳房密度的VLM和BI-RADS分类的答案、信心和解释之间的一致性。 我们执行对问题的可控扰动、多重选择选择命令、图像和评估三个产出的变化。 我们的结果表明,即使乳房X光照片被改变,信心也不会下降。 shuffing the options也改变大多数VLMs的答案. 值得注意的是,在有些情况下,一个模型自己陈述的推理与它的最后答案相矛盾,单是区分的准确性是不能捕捉到的,而只能支配AI生成的答案是否可以信任。

articles.title: Can the Confidence and Decisions of System 1 Models Be Trusted? An Explainability and Perturbation Audit of Jev-Style Decision Models
articles.content: "System 1" decision models (pioneered by TypeSafe AI's Jev) replace autoregressive text generation with a single forward pass returning typed probability distributions over declared schemas (Choice, Score, Noul). While deployed for low-latency routing and automated triage, their statistical calibration and post-hoc explainability remain uncharacterized. We introduce an open, deterministic audit benchmark evaluating System 1 decision models across calibration under label-preserving perturbations, cross-question interference, and post-hoc attribution faithfulness. Evaluating five open-weight models (0.8B to 27B) alongside generative System 2 baselines -- both single-token logprob scoring and structured JSON/CoT decoding -- across NLI (e-SNLI), adversarial syntactic shortcuts (HANS), synthetic clinical triage (N=900), prompt injection defense (Tensor Trust, N=250), and an 86-case logic-gate trigger suite yields five findings: (1) provider confidence is an exact closed-form dispersion transform (1 - H(p)/ln K on sub-10B models; normalized margin on Clef-27B) rather than empirical accuracy; (2) bundling multiple questions in one request induces directional cross-question interference (11.7% to 22.4% binary flips on Tev1-0.8B, vs. 0.1% to 0.2% on Tev1-4B); (3) System 1 models with >= 4B parameters are faster and better calibrated under syntactic shifts (ECE_w = 0.030 to 0.087) than logprob (0.144) and JSON (0.378) baselines; (4) for prompt-injection defense (N=250), >= 4B models achieve 0.988 to 0.998 AUROC with up to 95.2% recall and 0.0% false alarms at 48 to 60 ms; and (5) single-pass inference makes 512-coalition XAI interactive (1.3 to 3.2 s/input), while KernelSHAP with a logit link (S1-SHAP) mitigates softmax saturation on disjunctive OR gates (89.3% to 100.0% gate recovery vs. 57.1% to 82.1% in prob space; p_adj = 0.004).
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 系统1模式的信心和决定能否得到信任? Jev-Style决定模式的解释性和干扰性审计
articles.content_zh: "System 1"决定模型(由TypeSafe AI's Jev所标出)将自递式文本生成替换为单个前传回打出概率分布于所申报的chemas上(Choice, Score, Noul). 虽然部署用于低纬度路由和自动化分解,但其统计校正和hoc后可解释性仍无特征. 我们采用了一个开放的、决定性的审计基准,在保留标签的扰动、交叉问题干扰和事后归属的忠诚下,对系统1决策模型进行校准。 评估5个开口量模型(0.8B至27B)和基因系统2基线 -- -- 单托对数分和结构化JSON/CoT解码 -- -- 跨越NLI(e-SNLI)、对抗性合成捷径(HAS)、合成临床分解(N=900)、即时注射防御(Tensor Trust,N=250),以及86个案例逻辑门触发套件得出5个结论:(1) 供应商信心是一个精确的封闭式散射变换(1-H(p)/ln K在子-10B模型上;Clef-27B上的正常比值)而不是经验精度;(2) 在一项请求中将多个问题捆绑在一起,诱发方向交叉问题干扰(11.7%到22.4%的Tev1-0.8B上的二分翻,对Tev1-4B上的0.1%到0.2%); (3) 具有QQ4B参数的系统1模型比logprob(0.144)和JSON(0.378)基线更快,更能校准(ECE_w=0.030至0.087);(4)用于即时注射防御(N=250),QQ4B模型达到0.988至0.998 AUROC,在48至60米处可召回高达95.2%的警报和0.00%的假警报;(5)单通推论使512-COAL XAI(1.3至3.2 s/put)具有交互性,而具有logt链接(S1-SHAP)的KernelSHAP则能减轻散合OR门上软马克思饱和度(89.3%至100.0%的闸口恢复率对57.1%至82.1%;p_adj=0.04)。

articles.title: Text Grouping Changes Completion-Time Comparisons in Long-Form Simultaneous Speech Translation
articles.content: Does grouping translation updates before speech synthesis change the measured completion gap between two translators? We compare StreamAtt with its fixed-audio-history baseline on ten English-German talks. For each translation, we keep the intended text and its availability times fixed and vary how updates are grouped for synthesis. Four-second grouping increases StreamAtt's mean completion lead from 106.6 to 229.1 seconds with XTTS-v2, but reduces it from 169.5 to 146.5 seconds with Piper. Both produce shorter audio; different changes in playback idle account for the opposite effects. These directions recur on a separately selected twenty-talk panel. In continuing CosyVoice 3 sessions, grouping instead leaves paired audio unchanged and delays completion on nineteen of twenty blocks. A speech-timing comparison therefore needs to specify how text enters synthesis, not just which synthesizer is used. Recognition and automatic word timing describe the outputs, but do not establish translation accuracy or intelligibility.

articles.title: Detecting AI-Authored Text in Authentic Student Writing: Evidence from PISA 2025
articles.content: AI-text detectors reach near-perfect scores in evaluations that contrast fully human-written texts with texts generated from researcher-designed prompts. In authentic student writing, however, AI use is voluntary and often partial. We study this setting with the PISA 2025 FLA dataset, in which 15-year-olds in Germany wrote English argumentative essays with and without access to a gpt-4o-mini-based chatbot. Keystroke, clipboard and chat logs let us trace every character of the final essay to its origin. From this provenance, we derive text- and sentence-level labels for human-written, AI-generated and mixed text, and for text written after chatbot use without traceable AI material. We evaluate a feature-based detector and a classifier on frozen Llama-3.1-8B embeddings, both adapted from top-ranked shared-task systems. Both separate AI from human text reliably (macro-F1 up to 0.96 for texts and 0.95 for sentences), independently of spelling errors. The feature-based detector, however, relies on lexical complexity, which a simple student-style rewriting prompt removes (AI recall 0.92 $\to$ 0.60 with gpt-4o-mini, 0.41 with Qwen3). The embedding-based detector stays robust for whole texts (AI recall $\geq$ 0.94) but not for single sentences (AI recall as low as 0.59). Mixed text falls between the two classes, and text without traceable AI material is classified as human-written in about 95\% of texts.

articles.title: Phrase-Level Speculative Decoding on a Frozen Target
articles.content:
Speculative decoders raise throughput by banking more target tokens per forward pass, and Medusa, EAGLE-3, DFlash and DSpark all do it the same way: more candidates that survive verification. All of them draft in the target's own vocabulary, so one node of the candidate tree is one target token, and the tokenizer makes that unit look like a constant. It is not. BPE's pretokenizer splits on whitespace before merges are learned, so no multi-word string can ever become a single token: in Qwen3-4B, "United States of America" is four tokens and no adjacent pair of them exists as one entry, so a phrase is out of reach of any method drafting in the target's vocabulary.
  We change the unit. A small MLP head reads the frozen target's hidden state and predicts a one- to three-word phrase as one entry in a separate draft vocabulary; greedy longest-match expansion maps it back into the target's own tokens, and N candidates are verified in one forward pass behind a prefix-tree mask, so the change is orthogonal to tree depth and width. The target and its tokenizer stay frozen and a candidate is accepted only while it matches the target's own argmax, so the served output is identical to greedy decoding up to floating-point tie-breaking.
  On one A5000 at batch 1, against HuggingFace generate(), a 21.94M head (0.545% of Qwen3-4B) reaches 2.391x on GSM8K, 2.444x on MATH-500 and 1.544x on MT-Bench. Because the head's output layer is one row of 257 parameters per entry, the draft vocabulary size is the parameter budget: an 8,000-entry head is 3.434M parameters, 0.0854% of the target and 64x smaller than EAGLE-3's drafter, and keeps 92.3% of the larger head's GSM8K tokens per pass. With EAGLE-3 run on same prompts and baseline, our 21.94M head is ahead of tree-16 on both maths sets and behind tree-60 on every set.

articles.title: Can Frontier Auto Researchers Reconstruct Human Research Decisions in AI?
articles.content: Scientific research has long been driven by substantial human effort, from reviewing prior work and identifying research gaps to designing specific solutions. Recent advances in harness-based agent systems have given rise to increasingly capable Auto Researchers, which can autonomously carry out these tasks and, increasingly, entire end-to-end research workflows. Yet despite their rapidly growing capabilities, how closely the research decisions and outputs produced by auto researchers align with those of human experts remains underexplored. We investigate this gap through the lens of research reconstruction and study: Given comparable research context, how similar are the research decisions and outputs produced by Auto Researchers to those of human researchers in AI research? To answer this question, we introduce AutoResearcher-Human Research Similarity (AutoHRS), a stage-wise evaluation framework for assessing how faithfully auto researchers reconstruct human research artifacts across different stages of the scientific workflow. Using 152 ICLR oral papers as our corpus, we generate 456 research trajectories spanning different stages of the research process. Applying AutoHRS to these trajectories, we find that current Auto Researchers frequently fail to recover key research decisions and their resulting artifacts across multiple stages of the research process.

articles.title_zh: Can Frontier 自动研究员 在AI中重建人类研究决定?
articles.content_zh: 从审查先前的工作和查明研究差距到设计具体的解决办法,科学研究长期以来一直受到人类大量努力的推动。 最近在以取用为主的代理系统方面取得的进展已使汽车研究人员的能力日益增强,他们可以自主地执行这些任务,并越来越多地完成整个端到端的研究工作流程. 然而,尽管其能力迅速增长,汽车研究者所作的研究决定和产出与人类专家的研究决定和产出如何接近,仍然没有得到充分探讨。 我们从研究和研究的角度来研究这一差距: 根据可比的研究背景,汽车研究人员所作的研究决定和产出与人工智能研究中人类研究人员的研究决定和产出有何相似之处? 为了回答这个问题,我们引入了AutoResearcher-Human Research相似性(AutoHRS),这是评估如何在科学工作流程的不同阶段忠实地重建人类研究文物的分阶段评估框架. 我们利用152份国际天主教法学研究中心的口述论文作为我们的工具,产生了456个研究轨迹,跨越研究过程的不同阶段。 将AutoHRS应用于这些轨迹,我们发现目前的Auto Researchers经常无法在研究过程的多阶段中回收关键研究决定及其产生的文物.

articles.title: Path-Level Structural and Semantic Alignment for Hierarchical Multi-Label Text Classification
articles.content: Hierarchical multi-label text classification (HMTC) requires models to capture both structural dependencies among labels and the fine-grained semantics of labels at different hierarchy levels. Existing methods often model hierarchy through prediction constraints or representations of individual labels and local relations. Structural and semantic supervision, however, are usually formulated separately. We instead use complete root-to-node label paths as a shared unit for both. Our framework introduces two auxiliary training objectives while retaining a standard multi-label classifier at inference. PathSimNCE aligns document representations with hierarchical paths using hierarchy-aware contrastive targets. These targets provide graded supervision for structurally related paths while preserving explicit supervision for the ground-truth paths. The complementary semantic objective uses LLM-generated, document-conditioned descriptions of the same positive paths. It thereby provides context-specific label semantics beyond static label representations. Experiments on three benchmarks show consistent improvements: structural alignment is particularly beneficial in deeper hierarchies, while semantic alignment provides additional gains for fine-grained labels.

articles.title_zh: 分级多标签文本分类路径级结构和语义对齐
articles.content_zh: 分级多标签文本分类(HMTC)需要模型既能捕捉到标签之间的结构依赖性,又能捕捉到不同级别上标签的细纹语义. 现有方法往往通过预测限制或表达个人标签和地方关系来模拟等级. 然而,结构监督和语义监督通常单独制定。 我们使用完整的从根到节点的标签路径作为两者的共享单位. 我们的框架引入了两个辅助培训目标,同时在推论中保留一个标准的多标签分类器. PathSimNCE使用分级意识对比目标将文档表达式与分级路径相协调. 这些目标为结构相关路径提供分级监督,同时对地面真相路径保持明确的监督。 互补的语义目标使用LLM生成的,具有文档条件的相同正路描述. 因此它提供了超出静态标签表达的上下文特定标签语义. 三个基准的实验显示,一致性的改进:结构相接对更深层次尤其有益,而语义相接则为细纹标签提供了额外的收益.

articles.title: Unprompted coordination through shared memory in LLM agents: a locked two-implementation replication and extension
articles.content: Coordination between large language-model agents has become a central question for AI safety and software engineering, as such agents are deployed in groups that share infrastructure. Existing research tells the agents that partners exist or asks them to coordinate. Whether coordination arises through shared state alone, with nothing disclosing that anyone else is present, is the key question for deployments that share caches and memory between agents, yet it has rarely been examined, and never with independent replication; this study does both. Four agents each received a short arithmetic task and a key-value store presented to each as its own scratch space; two held complementary halves of one computation, and no prompt mentioned other agents, sharing or collaboration. For reliability, the environment was rebuilt independently from a written protocol, and both implementations ran under hashed locks on design, data and analysis. The results bear novelty value in three respects. Joint success occurred only through the shared store. Whether a model coordinated depended not on its vendor tier but on whether it wrote its intermediate result and looked at the store again, and one ordinary sentence, "check your workspace again before submitting", switched that second look on and off. The findings held under replication. For practice, state shared between agents is a communication channel and should be separated, namespaced and logged. For research, designs should be locked before the data, and the parse rule, endpoint and parameters reported. Future work should test open-weight models and separate using another agent's output from intending to communicate.

articles.title_zh: 通过 LLM 代理中共享内存进行未及时协调:锁定了两个执行复制和扩展
articles.content_zh: 大型语言模型代理人之间的协调已成为AI安全和软件工程的核心问题,因为这些代理人被部署在共享基础设施的团体中. 现有的研究告诉代理人存在伙伴或要求它们进行协调。 协调是否仅通过共享状态而产生,而没有任何信息显示其他人在场,是代理人之间共享缓存和内存的部署的关键问题,然而它却很少被审查,从不独立复制;本研究两者兼有. 4名代理人每人收到一个简短的算术任务和一个键值商店,作为各自抓取的空间;2名代理人持有一个计算结果的互补部分,没有及时提及其他代理人,共享或协作. 为了可靠性,环境的重建是独立于书面协议的,两个实施都由设计、数据和分析方面的散装锁来进行。 结果在三个方面具有了新的价值。 联合成功只能通过共享商店实现. 一个模型的协调是否不取决于其供应商级别,而是取决于它是否写出中间结果并再次查看了商店,一个普通的句子"在提交前再次检查您的工作空间",切换了第二次的外观. 调查结果正在复制。 在实践中,代理人之间共享的状态是一个通信通道,应当分离,命名和登录. 就研究而言,设计应在数据之前锁定,并报告分析规则、终点和参数。 未来的工作应当测试开量模型,并使用另一种剂的输出与打算进行交流分开.

articles.title: BDBBQ: A Human-AI Collaborative Benchmark for Bengali Social Bias in LLMs
articles.content: Despite growing attention to social bias in large language models (LLMs), existing bias benchmarks provide limited coverage of culturally grounded evaluation in Bengali, particularly within Bangladesh's sociocultural context. To address this gap, we develop a bilingual extension of BanglaBBQ comprising 61,312 question-answering instances across 12 social categories in English and Bengali. The benchmark incorporates balanced answer permutations, contrasting question framings, and both ambiguous and disambiguated contexts to systematically examine model performance and stereotype-aligned bias across languages. We validate the dataset through structural checks, 220 statistical tests, and expert annotation of 150 instances by four annotators, achieving strong inter-annotator agreement (Fleiss' \k{appa}=0.8349). We evaluate eight LLMs across 490,496 instances and identify five key findings. First, disambiguated contexts yield substantially greater accuracy improvements in Bengali (+36.59 percentage points) than in English (+17.71). Second, all evaluated models exhibit lower accuracy in Bengali, although Mistral-Nemo shows the smallest cross-lingual accuracy gap (5.12 percentage points). Third, stereotype-aligned bias exhibits language and model dependent variation, increasing in Bengali for Gemma 2 9B but decreasing for Mistral-Nemo. Fourth, higher accuracy does not necessarily correspond to lower stereotype-aligned bias. Finally, bias varies considerably across social categories, with Qwen 2.5 7B exhibiting stronger stereotype alignment in Bengali for Politics and Physical Appearance. These findings demonstrate that cross-lingual performance and social bias are distinct dimensions of LLM behavior and underscore the importance of culturally grounded, language-sensitive benchmarks for evaluating fairness beyond English-centric settings.

articles.title_zh: BDBBQ: 孟加拉语社会比亚语人与AI合作基准
articles.content_zh: 尽管人们日益关注大语言模式的社会偏见,但现有的偏见基准对孟加拉语基于文化的评价的覆盖面有限,特别是在孟加拉国的社会文化背景下。 为了弥补这一差距,我们开发了孟加拉语双语扩展,包括英语和孟加拉语12个社会类别的61 312个问答案例。 该基准包含平衡的答案结构、对比的问题框架以及模棱两可和含糊不清的背景,以便系统地审查各语文的示范业绩和陈规定型偏见。 我们通过结构检查、220个统计测试和四个注释员对150个案例的专家说明来验证数据集,从而达成强有力的注释员间协议(Fleiss' \k{appa}= 0.8349)。 我们评估了490 496个案例的8个有限责任公司,并确定了5个关键结果。 首先,相互矛盾的情况使孟加拉语的准确度(+36.59个百分点)大大高于英语的准确度(+17.71)。 其次,所有被评价的模型在孟加拉语的准确度都较低,尽管Mistral-Nemo显示的跨语言准确度差距最小(5.12个百分点)。 孟加拉语中Gemma 2 9B的偏差增加, 第四,更高的准确性不一定与较低的陈规定型偏差相对应。 最后,不同社会类别的偏见差别很大,Quen 2.5 7B在孟加拉政治和身体外观方面表现出了更强烈的定型观念。 这些调查结果表明,跨语言表现和社会偏见是LLM行为的独特方面,并强调了基于文化的、对语言敏感的基准对于评价超越以英语为中心的环境的公平性的重要性。

articles.title: More Than Just Style: Benchmarking Personality Influence in Large Language Models
articles.content: In addition to the effects of explicit input prompts and instructions, large language model outputs are influenced by underlying behavioral preferences similar to human personality tendencies. These tendencies can affect how models interpret situations and make decisions. However, their influence is difficult to disentangle from the effects of model capabilities and instructions. Therefore, we introduce SPACE, a benchmark framework combining a controlled evaluation protocol with complementary datasets for personality verification, capability assessment, and hierarchical situational tasks. Controlled comparisons across guidance conditions help distinguish personality influence from measured capability changes and immediate instruction effects. Experimental results demonstrate that although prompting can shift generation style, models' internal personality tendencies are persistent and not readily overridden by opposing instructions. Furthermore, these underlying tendencies have an observable influence on LLM task performance, highlighting the need for greater attention to these characteristics and potential applications. Training code and SPACE benchmark specifications are available at https://github.com/Niklauseik/SPACE-training.

articles.title_zh: 更简洁的风格:大语言模型中的个人影响基准
articles.content_zh: 除了明确输入提示和指示的效果外,大型语言模型输出还受类似人类个性倾向的内在行为偏好所影响. 这些趋势会影响模型如何解释情况并作出决定。 然而,它们的影响力很难从模型能力和指令的效果中分辨出来. 因此,我们采用了空间这一基准框架,结合了控制下的评价协议和补充数据集,用于人格核查、能力评估和分级情况任务。 对各种指导条件的可控比较有助于区分个性影响与测量的能力变化和即时指示效应。 实验结果表明,虽然催化可以改变生成风格,但模型的内部个性倾向是持久的,不会轻易被相反的指示所压倒. 此外,这些基本趋势对LLM任务执行产生了可观察到的影响,突出表明需要更多地注意这些特点和潜在的应用。 培训守则和空间基准规格见https://github.com/Niklauseik/SPACE-training。
